articleTitle: Fuzzy delphi method: Issues and challenges
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Fuzzy Delphi Method (FDM) is the modified and enhanced version of the classical Delphi technique. Improvement was made to rectify the imperfection of traditional Delphi Method (DM) that leads to low convergence in retrieving outcomes, loss of important information, and long progress of investigation. Nevertheless, this approach has been employed in various application domains, including humanities, management, business, physical science, and engineering. Furthermore, the literature has exposed numerous key issues in relation to the existing FDM that need to be resolved with regard to the classical DM. Hence, the analysis obtained from the existing literature highlighted two key issues, which were; i) most FDM ignored certain important characteristics of DM, and ii) lack of explanation on how FDM obtained controlled feedback with the lack of iteration process. Additionally, it was observed that there had been lack of comparison between decision outcomes obtained based on FDM and the decision outcomes obtained from the traditional DM.

articleTitle: Dynamic pricing considering strategic customers
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Dynamic pricing is increasingly applied to supply chain management and the key of successful application of dynamic pricing is to correctly understand consumer's behavior. In the face of a variety of dynamic pricing strategies, more and more consumers become smarter, and they forecast the future price before making a purchase decision. These types of consumers are called the strategic consumers, corresponding to the myopic consumers. In this paper, we study the dynamic pricing problem considering the strategic consumer behavior, and establish the game model between the retailer and consumers. First, we establish the dynamic pricing model of the retailer in the case of supply exceeding demand and demand exceeding supply. Second, we list the equilibrium conditions for the optimal dynamic pricing strategies, derive the optimal dynamic pricing strategies, and finally analyze the result with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A research on tracing code of culture of food safety traceability based on RFID and improved EPC
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In regarding to problems existing in the EPC (Electronic Product Code) coding structure model used in food safety traceability, combined with features of food safety traceability, based on host-guest thought improves the design, this paper establishes a traceable safety information coding for beef cattle based on EPC. The coding systematically solves the coding problems of key information in the procedures of tracing the quality and safety of beef cattle, which is featured with low cost and strong scalability. Operation in the field indicates that the coding system is well in running to provide encoding support for establishment of traceability system for quality and safety of beef cattle.

articleTitle: High-performance work systems and job satisfaction: Mediation role of organizational identification
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the social exchange perspective, this paper explore the relationship between high-performance work systems and the employee job satisfaction, and analyze the mediation effect of organizational identification. Through more than 200 employees at different levels in the enterprise investigation and using hierarchical regression analysis to deal with the data, the results show that: (1) High-performance work systems are positively associated with job satisfaction. Through the questionnaire analysis with high-performance work systems, we gain six dimensions of high-performance work systems: common development training system, intensive employee involvement, strict recruitment/selection, systemic performance management, timely information sharing and clear job design, and the six dimensions all have significant positive effect on job satisfaction. (2) High-performance work systems are positively associated with organizational identification. (3) Organizational identification plays partial mediation role between high-performance work systems and job satisfaction.

articleTitle: Modeling of multi-train seat inventory control based on revenue management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As ticket income is the main part of railway passenger transportation revenue, rail companies have to deal with seat inventory control problem to maximize the overall expected revenues. This paper develops a multi-train seat inventory control model (MSIC) based on the Revenue Management (also known as Yield Management) theory. This model introduces Origin-Destination (OD) inventory as a constraint by assigning the number of seats to each train and OD to control the seat inventory capacity among different trains. Comparing with the existing models, this model makes it possible to maximize the overall revenue of a whole train line plan rather than a single train, which is more suitable for the practice of railway operation. Meanwhile, the model can also provide theory and tool for marketing staff monitoring and adjusting ticket allocation to improve ticket sales. A case study on a partial train line plan of Beijing-Guangzhou High Speed Railway (HSR) proves that the MSIC model can increase the overall revenue by optimizing passenger distribution on different trains.

articleTitle: Relationship analysis of the urban rail service quality, passenger satisfaction and loyalty based on the structural equation model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Urban rail transit has been selected as the research object for this paper. Firstly, an index system has been established to evaluate the passengers' satisfaction and loyalty from the perspectives of service quality, passenger satisfaction and loyalty. Secondly, a passenger satisfaction and loyalty evaluation questionnaire for the urban rail transit service quality has been designed and a survey has been conducted. At last, based on the survey data, this paper has used the structural equation method to establish a model to analyze the relationship among the urban rail transit service quality, passenger satisfaction and loyalty. The model has made hypothesis on the relationship of city rail transit service quality and passenger satisfaction, passenger satisfaction and passenger loyalty, city rail transit service quality and passenger loyalty. (1) The urban rail transit service quality has a direct and positive effect on the passenger satisfaction. (2) The passenger satisfaction has a direct and positive effect on the passenger loyalty. (3) Part of the rail transit service quality factors has a direct and positive effect on the passenger loyalty. (4) The effect of the urban rail transit service quality on passenger loyalty was partially mediated by the passenger satisfaction.

articleTitle: Low-carbon logistics distribution route planning with improved particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By introducing a carbon emission calculation method, which considers the vehicle speed and load, a low-carbon logistics distribution route optimization model with the targets of minimizing the transport costs and carbon emissions is established. We propose a kind of improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve this model. Since the particle swarm optimization algorithm is easy to plunge into local optimum in its running late, the particle will conduct random mutation in the improved algorithm when it exceeds the maximum number of stagnations. The simulation results of the numerical example demonstrate that the new algorithm is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Vehicle routing optimization of urban distribution with self-pick-up lockers
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the explosive development of E-commerce in China, an efficient accurate package distribution is badly needed, causing urban distribution Last Mile Problem. Under the circumstance of worse traffic congestion and environment pollutions in today's cities, not only accuracy and speed, but also alleviation of traffic congestion, air pollutions are highly required while solving Last Mile Problem. Self-pick-up locker has been tried to reach these requirements in recent years. Nevertheless, how to optimize the delivery vehicle routing with self-pick-up locker and then saving distribution cost of express enterprises is important for the popularization of self-pick-up locker remained to be seen. Based on above, a vehicle routing optimization model with self-pick-up lockers is set up, considering CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission, customer time window and congestion. Then the case of Mingguangcun, Beijing is brought into the model to reach a solution. What's been found in this paper should be helpful for express enterprises to promote the use of self-pick-up lockers.

articleTitle: Bidirectional CABOSFV for high dimensional sparse data clustering
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The classic algorithm for high dimensional sparse data clustering, CABOSFV, is unidirectional which increases the complexity of parameter adjustment along with the instability of clustering quality. This paper proposes Bidirectional CABOSFV by defining Bidirectional Sparse Feature Vector (B-SFV) and addition-subtraction of B-SFVs. The experiments on UCI data sets show that Bidirectional CABOSFV retains the superiority on high dimensional sparse data clustering, and the efficiency and quality has been improved.

articleTitle: Satisfaction, trust and online purchase intention: A study of consumer perceptions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper tries to do the research of analyzing the relation of the customer trust, the customer satisfaction and purchase intention under the electronic commerce shopping environment. Drawing on the theory of customer trust, customer satisfaction and purchase intention, based on a survey of 102 respondents from the University in China, the United Kingdom, and the United States, the results showed that there is significant correlation between satisfaction and trust, satisfaction and purchase intention, trust and purchase intention, and more than 50% of respondents chose Taobao and Tmall, and the second is Amazon when they shopping onling. It could be expected that this kind of study is able to provide suggestion and guide for internet merchant.

articleTitle: Research on the improvement of human error in the process of production operation — Taking the fatigue operation in the production as the object of study
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Nowadays, safety in production has become the focus of people's attention in the enterprise, because it involves not only the problem of economic benefits, but also the personal security problems. A large number of data shows that half of most accidents are due to human errors. The failure of people caused by fatigue as an important part of human errors has become an important reason of accident. In order to reduce the accidents caused by fatigue, prevent the damage in the work environment, and reduce the fatigue caused by the job is very important. In this paper, the significance and necessity of fatigue work are described In the first chapter, the second chapter introduces the concept of human factor engineering, the development process of human factor engineering and the relationship between the fatigue and human factor engineering and the theory of fatigue and how to use the methods of human factor engineering to improve the working fatigue. In the third chapter, using an example to illustrate the process of implementation by the ways above and the results achieved in the enterprise.

articleTitle: Smart manufacturing and supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Within the ongoing fourth industrial revolution, smart manufacturing will plays critical role in national level for the growth of the national economy, but also firm level for the sustainable development of the manufacturing activities and the whole supply chain. This paper aims to explore the influences of smart manufacturing to supply chain management, and based on broad literature review this paper also develops several propositions for further explore insights of improving supply chain performance under the context of smart manufacturing.

articleTitle: Improve TSP problem allowing multiple vehicles distribution
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: TSP (Traveling Salesman Problem) is the generalization and simplification of a variety of complex issues that arise in many areas, which is easy to describe but difficult to solve as an NP complete problem. Based on the TSP problem, we allow more than one vehicles to distribute goods in the transportation network, and each node in the network can be serviced by more than one vehicles. We build a more realistic model of TSP transportation and distribution, and solve the model.

articleTitle: Design of navigation system and transmitter based on GPS and GSM
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: GPS is one of the significant tools from our homes to the industrial level where there is much of technological exploration that proves the easy work in tracing or tracking of objects. This paper analyzes the best major components with features in designing the transmitter in a navigation system based on GPS and GSM. Rapid advancements in automation processes has brought much concentration of what tools and under which conditions are best for reliable performance of the required applied system basing on power consumption, memory or storage of data as well as the antenna capabilities. Therefore the GPS is one of the Global navigation satellite systems which have advanced its crucial functionality based on satellites.

articleTitle: Research on the cooperation and competition strategies of port based on hinterland traffic condition
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: On the basis of analyzing customer's choice behavior, this paper constructs a utility function of port and obtains an equilibrium pricing strategy before and after competition and cooperation by applying Nash equilibrium. In addition, it also analyzes the impact of hinterland traffic condition on the competition and cooperation between ports. The analyzed results demonstrate that with the improvement of hinterland traffic condition, part of ports use cooperation strategy, which can not only improve the overall profit and share of the cooperative ports, but also can enhance the interest and market share of non-competitive ports so that the improvement of overall interest and market share of regional port group can be realized.

articleTitle: Research on the location of the railway logistics center based on existing railway freight station
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to further perfect China's railway logistics infrastructure and promote the railway transportation to better integrate into the logistics system, it is necessary to build a railway logistics center to provide integrated logistics service. This paper mainly studies the problem of location of railway logistics center based on existing railway freight station. Firstly, the location assessment index system is established according to the factors of the location of railway logistics center, and then selects the appropriate comprehensive evaluation model, finally the improved DEA model is used to analyze the location problem of the railway logistics center in a certain railway area, and verify the operability of the model.

articleTitle: Pricing for perishable goods in advance selling strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Perishable goods are those whose value decay rapidly over time. To reach the maximum profit, vendors should sell them as soon as possible ever since they are available on market. Advance selling strategy refers to sell a product before it is ready for sale and this helps sellers to observe the market response and adjust its operational plans. With the rapid development of E-commerce, it becomes much easier and cheaper for both sellers and buyers to search for desired information. Advance selling has become an effective and popular sales strategy for perishable goods selling. In this paper, we aim to develop a pricing model for perishable goods in the context of advance selling. Consumers are classified to two categories based on the shopping habit, namely strategic consumer and conventional consumer. The whole sales process is divided into two stages, which are advance selling stage and normal sales stage. A pricing model is proposed in advance selling strategy to achieve maximum profit for the seller in this paper. The best pricing of two phases can be obtained when the market reaches equilibrium. Numerical computation and sensitive analysis are conducted in the end of this paper. The results show that the best prices grow with the demand and depend on the ratio between the quantities of potential consumer for the two sales stages.

articleTitle: Study on safety production management improvement of small and medium sized chemical enterprises
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Under the premise of analyzing the present situation of small and medium-sized chemical enterprises, adopted the industrial engineering method in improve production safety research combined with the 5S method in actual production, from the aspects of safety production management and 5S method among small and medium-sized chemical enterprise production and operation of security issues put forward some suggestions for chemical enterprises.

articleTitle: The coupling-coordination relationship between accessibility and economic linkage in jing-jin-ji metropolitan area
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The research about the coordinated relationship between transportation accessibility and economic linkage has important theoretical and practical significance. This paper uses the revised spatial interaction model to analyze the rail network accessibility and its spatial pattern and then explores the gravity model to calculate intensity of the economic linkage between the cities in Jing-Jin-Ji metropolitan area. Based on them, construct a coupling coordination model to evaluate the coordinated relationship between the accessibility and economic linkage in Jing-Jin-Ji metropolitan area. Results show that the spatial disparity of the coupling coordination degree between accessibility and economic linkage in Jing-Jin-Ji metropolitan area is extremely uneven, with a large difference in coupling degree, and poor accessibility and coupling degree of economic linkage in edge cities. The coupling coordination types of cities in Jing-Jin-Ji metropolitan area are different.

articleTitle: A research on the model of university apartment occupancy distribution based on the student preferences
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Generally, Almost university apartment ware allocated by different colleges and classes in random. And without considering between students of different living habits and difference in character. And this might cause contradiction and conflict between students in the same dorm, which can bring some bad effects to colleges and society. This paper considers that when we allocated the students' apartment we should considering between students of different living habits and difference in character and other accommodation preferences. By established the Fuzzy clustering model based on Fuzzy, the students will be divided into Fuzzy cluster according to the accommodation preference, and the optimization strategy of the dormitory allocation considering the students' preference is also given by this allocation model. This kind of university apartment assignment method that considering the student's preferences, which put forward a kind of effective solution to alleviate the problem of frequent problems in the same dormitory in Colleges and universities. On this basis, combined with Internet technology will this distribution method is embedded into the student apartment management system, the traditional student apartment management system process reengineering, build a new model of the “Smart Apartment” management in Colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Sea-rail combined transport model based on queuing theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Currently the research literature on container sea-rail combined transport, mostly are from the point of cost, or starting from the transportation line, or from the perspective of time window, but lack of theoretical support with an integrated effect to optimize the multimodal transport of goods. In this paper, it considers the arrival and departure of the whole process of the container, establishing a container transport model based on queuing theory. The model is a batch arrival and batch service model. The model is a batch arrival, batch service model, accurately describing the circulation process of the container on sea-rail combined transport port.

articleTitle: How inter-organizational ICT impact on supply chain performance with considering supply chain integration and uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper adds to our understanding of how ICT helps to improve SC performance. We investigate both indirect and direct effects of ICT and find based on data from Chinese manufacturers that inter-organizational ICT has a positive effect via SCM-practices if the uncertainty is high. We do not find support for that relationship if uncertainty is low. No support is found for an direct effect of inter-organizational ICT in high uncertainty, while it improves performance if uncertainty is low.

articleTitle: The risk management under conditions of contract for EPC in overseas projects
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: More and more companies go abroad to response to China's policy “the Belt and Road”. However, many companies suffer from great loss when they go out so that estimate risks factors in overseas project is very important. The interactions between the complex factors can be structured in a model that can help one to make a rational judgment. The EPC Contract risk model developed in this study is based on the Analytic Hierarchy Process improved by the addition of a Delphi survey. Then presents measures for avoiding risks in such form of contract to reduce loss in the process, so that we can increase profit in overseas projects.

articleTitle: Study on coordinated relationship between urban rail transit and land-use
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper establishes an evaluation index system of coordinated relationship between urban rail transit and land use. And the data envelopment analysis (DEA) model is applied to evaluate the coordinated relationship between urban rail transit and land use of Beijing from 2001 to 2014. Evaluation results that are generated by the model are conducive to analyze the change rule of coordination and find out the main factors which restrict coordinated development. The results show that, on the whole, Beijing rail transit and land-use fail to realize coordinated development. The contributing value of ratio of employees to citizens is maximum in the input values of land use system and the proportion of transit trips ranks first in the input values of urban rail transit system, which indicates the unbalanced space distribution of employment and residence and the low proportion of green transportation are key factors that have restricted the coordinated development between urban rail transit and land use. Additional, the improved values of invalid decision making units (DMU) are calculated in the paper with the guide of projection theory so as to provide a reference for the development of urban rail transit and land use.

articleTitle: Research on O2O model of fresh products
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper, based on the theories of O2O and fresh products, analyzes the advantages of O2O model on fresh products. And then, it points out the problems of domestic fresh products O2O model. The final part classifies fresh products into four categories according to two dimensions of value-added and the difficulty of e-commerce and proposed corresponding O2O model.

articleTitle: E-commerce distribution vehicle routing optimization research based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Logistics service is of great significance in e-commerce operations, the distribution Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) directly affect enterprises' logistics cost and distribution service quality. When formulating the plan, it's more in line with time actual needs to optimize algorithm from the characteristics of e-commerce than from the algorithm itself. This article designed a model and algorithm in accordance with the characteristics of electronic commerce, simulation results show that the optimal performance was improved greatly.

articleTitle: The risk assessment model of international multimodal transport system based on complex network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the introduction of “the Belt and Road” strategy, the extending and stable of international multimodal transport network become more and more important. The paper built a prism conceptual model of international multimodal transport network based on complex network theory. Furthermore, network interruptions are classified as “interruptions related to point” and “interruptions related to edge” and a risk assessment model were established. This model considered about various risks in transit, customs clearance and transportation existing in the international multimodal transport system and aimed at providing a theoretical basis for intermodal transport system operator to assess risks.

articleTitle: Mining organizational behaviors in collaborative logistics chain: An empirical study in a port
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Major advantages can be achieved for service improvement in modern logistics through effective collaborations. As a result, many logistics operational processes have developed into collaborative logistics chains involving different organizations. Organizational behaviors have a strong impact on the success of collaborations. However, it remains a challenging problem to reveal the real organizational behaviors in the collaborative logistics chains in a dynamic environment. This paper investigates the organizational behaviors in collaborative logistics chains from a process perspective using a synergy of process mining and social network analysis techniques. A method for mining organizational behaviors is presented, including process event log collection, work delivery flow discovery, and organization structure mining. An empirical study is conducted in an important Chinese port. Insights are obtained in terms of the working delivery patterns and organizational structures in the collaborative logistics chain. Recommendations to enhance the collaborations are given.

articleTitle: Based on the regression analysis model throughput forecast of port group in the upper yangtze river
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Along with emergency of the Yangtze River economic belt development strategy, Chongqing and Luzhou, Yibin port group as materials distributed in the upper reaches of the Yangtze River important nodes will play a powerful shipping hub and port, forming new engine of economic growth in Western China. From the data of Chongqing - Luzhou - Yibin port group cargo throughput, this paper aims to predict their future handling capacity based on the regression analysis model of the upper Yangtze river port throughput forecasting, which facilitates a rational analysis of the industry port and hinterland economy supply structure and space layout for people in the field. This method is beneficial to find new train and new measures for its development and worthy of reference for the industry and promotion.

articleTitle: Research on loading and routing problem of finished car logistics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the loading and routing problem of finished car logistics. Finished car logistics is a special commodity business which is produced accompany with the development of the whole vehicle economic. The logistics company loads up the finished cars in accordance with the customers' order, and arranges a suitable route to transport finished cars from manufacturer or distribution center to the customer. This paper discusses the loading and routing problem of finished car logistics where the logistics company uses double-deck transporter to transport multiple types of finished cars. The integer programming model is established, and the corresponding algorithm is designed. At first, according to the length of each layer of double-deck transporter and the size of commercial cars to be transported, the possible loading plan for each layer of car transporter is listed. Then, the disjoint shortest path from the distribution center to each customer is obtained by using the improved Dijkstra algorithm. For each shortest path, the demand of a customer who is far away from the distribution center should be met more priority than that of the customers who are nearer to the distribution center. Based on this idea, a heuristic loading algorithm is designed, and the loading and routing program with the shortest total traveling distance of all transporters is obtained. Finally, the feasibility of the model and algorithm is verified by an example with two types of transporters, three types of finished cars and nine customers. This paper ensures that all transporters' traveling distance is shortest and the full loading rate of each transporter can reaches 95%.

articleTitle: Study of railway passenger volume forecast based on grey forecasting model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Railway passenger volume forecast is an important basis of passenger traffic organization, it is also the base to set railway market policies of passenger transportation. The article establishes on the basis of previous studies. After analysis the data of railway passenger volume in recent years, the author chooses the Grey Model GM (1, 1) to forecast the trend of development of railway passenger volume in near three years. At the same time, the model passed average relative check, correlative check, and after-test residue check. Through the above check proved the validity of the GM (1, 1). Grey Model GM (1, 1) can be applied to short-term forecast of railway passenger volume. The model is based on a kind of relatively smooth index curve to fit the trend, it is suitable for time series analysis, but it is difficult to reflect the real volatility in the sequence of data. So the paper should consider more kinds of prediction model in further studies, instead of using single forecast model. It can reduce the error of prediction through using combination models.

articleTitle: Construction of the comprehensive student service platform for institutions of higher education exploration and practice
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Comprehensive Student Service Platform for institutions of higher education, an integrated management platform constructed based on unified development platform, unified database and re-arrangement of the “student business domain”, aims for realizing an integrated management of the student-oriented core business, fully covering the management of lifecycle business for students, from their registration to their stay until their graduation. Through using this service portal platform, the student service contents existing in each system have been re-arranged, re-categorized, re-defined and then integrated and are presenting in a full package in the comprehensive service portal platform, which is now able to provide intelligent services for users according to their characteristics; at the same time, business data analysis and reports will be generated for supporting the University heads' strategic decision-making.

articleTitle: Railway passenger ticket pricing policy portfolio
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Through summarizing the previous research about railway passenger fares, this paper proposed a new idea of fare policy portfolio. Considering the various characteristics of fare policy, this paper combined the traditional fare policies to form a pricing policy portfolio, established some mathematic models and also proved the existence of equilibrium price. Combination of market segmentation, market competition and dynamic pricing policy is a suitable railway fare policy portfolio which applies to China railway passenger transport development situation.

articleTitle: The market segmentation on passenger transportation of High-speed Railway with logistic regression model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this article, traveling passengers along Chongqing-Lichuan High-speed Railway line are regarded as research object in this paper. More than 5000 random sampling data of passenger travel and their characteristic along the Chongqing-Lichuan High-speed Railway line are obtained through SP/RP questionnaire design, and through the market segmentation by using Logistic regression to deal with these sampling data, three market segmentations are obtained: migrant workers, non-economic travel and business travel. Then three traveler characteristic indexes, age, monthly income and profession are statistically analyzed in each subordinate market segmentation, which could be helpful for the operators of Chongqing-Lichuan High-speed Railway to design differentiated products, thus realizing revenue maximization of passenger high-speed railway operation.

articleTitle: Research on emission reduction in supply chain under the energy performance contracting mode
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The paper focuses on the joint emission reduction problem in low-carbon supply chain with Energy Service Company's involvement in the `cap-and-trade' system. Two system dynamics model are included, cooperative R&D investment in emission reduction between the supplier and the manufacturer and Energy Service Company's R&D investment in emission reduction for the supply chain. We discuss the following key factors, Energy Service Company's sharing coefficient of the emission reduction benefits and carbon price. With the results of the models, comparative analysis of the cost, profits of the three companies and the emission reduction effects of the supply chain under different circumstances are presented, which can provide references for related decisions, to supply chain enterprises, Energy Service Company and the government.

articleTitle: Study on third rail current collector shoes wear of metro trains
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Subway train's collector shoes obtain electric energy from the power supply system, and the sliding contact between collector shoes and third rail could cause wear, which has a significant influence on the safety of train. Besides, the wear intensity is related to multiple factors. This paper presents a method of collector shoes wear based on the train operating mileage, makes prediction of the current degree of collector shoes wear, and tests the effectiveness of this method according to the experiment.

articleTitle: A game theory approach in subsidizing electric vehicle supply chain
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, a new four-echelon electric vehicle manufacturing supply chain model is proposed among government, electric/gasoline vehicle manufacturer, retailer and ultimate vehicle customer to study subsidy policy. Based on the Stackelberg leader/follower strategy concept, we consider two situations in subsidizing electric vehicle which are given subsidy to electric vehicle customer or electric vehicle manufacturer in early electric vehicle development stage. When the entire social profit achieves maximum value, the optimal sale price, the best amount of subsidies and the optimal profit for each agent in given supply chain are presented. Numerical examples and sensitivity analysis between some key parameters (i.e., energy price, the amount of subsidies) are given as results of this paper.

articleTitle: The optimization of delivery vehicle scheduling considering the actual road network factors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Vehicle scheduling of urban distribution is an important element of the logistics center's operation. The total scheduling cost is not only influenced by the satisfaction of customer service time window and the effective utilization of vehicle capacity, but also is closely related to the traffic flow, road capacity, vehicle saturation degree of intersection, traffic lights and road rules in actual road network. This paper proposes a two-stage model based on the shortest path's selection in the road network and vehicle scheduling, and designs a two-stage algorithm to solve it which combines both Dijkstra algorithm with improving labeling rules and simulated annealing algorithm with parallel local search rules. By taking a distribution center in Shahekou District of Dalian as an example, a vehicle scheduling plan in two weeks was calculated and compared with the original plan, which verified the effectiveness of the model and algorithm. Sensitivity analysis of two road network factors: traffic flow and forbidden roads, showed that change of traffic flow on the main road and moderate distance between forbidden roads and distribution centers have a great effect on vehicle schedules.

articleTitle: The analysis of the causes of alibaba's “double eleven shopping festival” sales growth rate slowing under the new normal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses about Alibaba under economic new normal “double eleven shopping festival” reasons for the slowing growth rate. We mainly analyze it from the following five dimensions. The first one is intensifying competition between the E-business in shopping festival double eleven. Ali is no longer a monolith. Second, Market education has been completed, consumers tend to be more rational. Third, logistics ability is limited, restrain the shopping “double eleven day” sales growth rate. Fourth, it is difficult to eradicate the disadvantages of online shopping. Five, huge amounts of fake problem have not been solved. Under the state of the economy to the new normal, if Ali wants to continue the myth of the “double a” turnover, it must be from the above five aspects to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Research on risk management of engineering project
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper introduces the basic concept and characteristics of engineering project risk, summarizes the risks of engineering project, points out the types of engineering project risk, applies risk analysis to this kind of risk, expounds the risk management process and related risk management methods of engineering project, and gives the strategies of engineering project risk management.

articleTitle: Optimizing berth operation system in container terminal by simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: A port is an important asset of the country and a national facility requiring lots of budget. Presently, approx. 900 berths of 31 ports are in operation in Korea and about 1 trillion Won is required for building the ports each year. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the appropriateness of berth configuration of the port and also evaluate whether scale of the berth built on the basis of estimated cargo volume at time of construction shall be still appropriate after a significant length of time. This study targets 11 steel berths of Gwangyang Port and desires to evaluate if configuration and scale of such berths are properly supporting the cargo handling. In order to evaluate configuration of the steel berths in Gwangyang Port, the author has collected Port-MIS data from 2011 to 2013 and analyzed the data for 3,591 cargo handling events out of 3,687 events except 96 events which did not intend to load or unload cargo. According to result of the optimal berth configuration using Arena Simulation, a configuration with 7 berths was proved to be the optimal configuration. That is, building 1 berth of class 50,000 ton, 3 berths of class 30,000 ton, 2 berths of class 5,000 ton and 1 berth of class 3,500 ton was confirmed to provide an efficient operation and service. It is expected to have an effect of saving national expenses by planning an optimal berth configuration in development of the berths through cargo volume estimation by establishing an optimal operation system through this study.

articleTitle: SEM research on the economic traffic demand management policy of Beijing based on the sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of urbanization and motorization, the vehicle ownership in Beijing have created a series of new records in the last five years and the road supply can't keep up with the traffic demand. The road congestion has become one of the main constraints of urban development. In order to alleviate the situation, the Beijing Traffic Management Bureau successively published a series of transportation demand management policies, such as parking fees charged standard, congestion cost, increasing fuel prices, trying to stimulate citizens to consciously reduce traffic demand and improve the urban travel predicament with the help of economic levers. However, the actual effect is much limited. On the basis of data collection and analysis, this study adopts the methods of structural equation modeling to explore the internal relationship between various effect factors and the extent of every factor to the management effect, and put forward any suggestions from the perspective of sustainable development. The results show that the economic measures have a greater effect on the mitigation of traffic congestion in Beijing, and the final results of the implementation of TDM are influenced by many factors, such as personal attributes, travel experience and others, furthermore, the extent of each factor is different. The research findings have a certain practical significance for Beijing to optimize the development and implementation of the economic traffic demand management policy.

articleTitle: Measuring the contribution degree of system and technological innovation to the economic growth
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As the important factors affecting the economic growth, system innovation and technological innovation have been widely attended. But there is little quantitative research on them. According to the theory of grey correlation analysis, this paper calculates the contribution degree to the economic growth through 10 indexes which can measure the system and technological innovation from 2005 to 2014. The results show that the contribution level of technological innovation to the economic growth is relatively stable, while reasonable system innovation will bring a surge in economic growth.

articleTitle: Application of a multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method in the purchase decision for library information resources
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to make an efficient and accurate information resources purchase of our library, and determine whether existing information resources need to renew or deselect and whether it is necessary to start new recourses purchase, a rational evaluation on information resources need to be conducted. The paper establishes an evaluation index system which has 3 levels, and uses methods of Delphi and superiority chart to calculate the weight of each index. Then, it classifies the third-level indexes into two types: quantitative indexes and qualitative indexes, and their membership degree can be obtained. Thus single-factor evaluation set of third-level indexes can be constructed, and finally the evaluation matrix can be constructed. Lastly, it makes evaluation to overall quality of information resources which need purchase decision by fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method: first, the bottom indexes are evaluated to obtain the evaluation results by using their weights and evaluation matrix; then these results are calculated as the evaluation matrix of the superior level to obtain the evaluation results of this level. This step is repeated, until the evaluation results of the first level are obtained.

articleTitle: A course-oriented book recommendation method based on library classification ontology
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the advent of Massive Open Online Course, or MOOC, academic librarians have already begun to participate in all aspects of MOOC. During the resource construction of a self-built MOOC platform, one issue that the author encounters is to recommend books in the library to disciplines or courses on the platform. Similarity between books and disciplines or courses of all levels is measured according to the structure of library classification ontology, based on which a method for recommending books to disciplines or courses is proposed. A numerical example is presented to show the working principle of the proposed method. With the embedded books in these courses and disciplines, academic librarians can provide in-depth subject service.

articleTitle: Research on the theory and application of IOII in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The integration of informatization and industrialization (IOII) is a policy guidelines proposed by the Chinese Government to promote the production upgrade and the transformation of economic development mode, which is given increasingly attention by academic circles. In this paper, a brief introduction to IOII is presented. The research collections of IOII required to study the theory and application are surveyed as well as the application evaluation. By summarizing the development and the existing concept of IOII, a new concept of IOII is put forward. Then by studying comparatively the process and the application evaluation of IOII, suggestions for future empirical investigation is offered.

articleTitle: The carbon emission reduction coordination of fresh supply chain based on the limited carbon quota and trading
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, against the background of low-carbon fresh supply chain, the government of carbon quota for the whole supply chain is limited and the carbon training policy is exist, we analyzed the centralized and distributed decision-making scenario how the producer and retailer cooperate on the carbon emission reduction, then studied the interaction between the emission reduction rate of producer and retailer, and comprise the average emission reduction rate of supply chain, also explore the impact of carbon trading price on emission reduction in four situations. The results shows that at what conditions of the carbon emissions reduction make sense, also get the conclusion that in centralized decision-making scenario, the emission reduction rate of supply chain is optimal, and with the higher training price, the emission reduction rate is higher too, vice versa. The conclusions provide some intellectual support for enterprises to make rational emission reduction strategies. This paper theoretically support the methods of cooperation for supply chain.

articleTitle: Political risks analysis for international project under the new situation-case study on the market of saudi arabia
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the deep development and implementation of the Chinese “the Belt and Road” strategy, more and more Chinese project contracting enterprises are rapidly stepping towards the international project contracting market and join the market competition. Meanwhile, these enterprises are faced with more complex and harsh risks overseas. Under a series of new situations, such as complicated and changing international situation, growing regional conflicts, increasingly rampant terrorist organizations, these enterprises are also confronted with increasingly huge political risks. Saudi Arabia is China's largest engineering contracting market in the Middle East, but the situation in the Middle East is becoming more and more deteriorative because of the Syrian Crises and the diplomatic crisis between Saudi Arabia and Iran. Therefore, Chinese enterprises are faced with serious political risks in Saudi Arabia. In this paper, we took the political risks that Chinese project contracting enterprises faced in Saudi Arabia under the new situation as an example, and optimized as well as combined various risk management technologies. Finally, we put forward systematic recommendations on effective control of political risks and duly handling the results caused by the political risks.

articleTitle: Production strategy with substitution under cap-and-trade regulation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper researches the two products production strategy under cap and trade policies by newsboy model. The green product could be regarded as an equivalent of the regular product. The useful conclusions can be obtained: 1) The establishment of cap and trade will benefit for the improvement of manufacture performance. 2) After green technology input, the quantity of regular product will raise and the quantity of green product under cap and trade will decrease. 3) There is expectant profit that could be earned through selling extra carbon emission or buy less carbon emission from outside market after green technology input under cap and trade policy.

articleTitle: The research of service innovation on the base of catering service process — Taking HaiDiLao as an example
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: People living standards have been improved as the service industry advancements, which has become an important part of national economy. Catering industry as one of the service industry has its unique service management model. With the development of economy, catering industry has achieved significant development, but few breakthroughs in service innovation. Especially the service process is mostly still in meal service, which leads to catering service homogenization. Through ten years of struggle, HaiDiLao, Sichuan hot pot brand business model has developed into a big scale food chain relying on its effective service innovation process. This article selects HaiDiLao as the research object, finds the reasons of its rapid development by analyzing its unique service process. And finally the author makes rough study on how to implement service innovation and copy the successful service model to other catering, thus pushing overall development of service industry.

articleTitle: Research on the collaboration of express service network based on resource integration
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: At present, China's express market demands and supply capacity of the express service providers is increasingly prominent. In the view of the problems such as scattered, small, bad in the express industry in China, the collaborative mode of service network based on horizontal resource integration is proposed. Through the cooperative operation of the express enterprise service network, it is not only beneficial to optimize the operation efficiency of the stock resources, but also help to cultivate the large-scale express enterprise which has the international competitiveness. This paper analyzes the distribution of the business volume of the express enterprise in the service networks cooperative operation, and achieves the benefit of the network cooperative pattern.

articleTitle: Research on the allocation decision of emergency material productivity reserve under the cooperation between the government and the enterprise
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: It is difficult for the general market supply to satisfy the huge emergency material demand under disruption events, which can be met by the productivity reserve. In this paper, we take the government as the main responsibility for emergency supplies under the premise of mutually beneficial cooperation between the government and the enterprise, and we establish a multi-objective programming model of storage quantity that satisfy the goals of timeliness, coverage level and cost with the aim of exploring the proportion of physical reserve and productivity reserve. We use an example to illustrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the model and the results suggest that the model can satisfy the goals and bring a cost saving. Besides, it is also concluded that with the demand increasing, the reserve quantity remains unchanged after rising, while the proportion of productivity reserve remains unchanged after dropping. The model provides a reference for the work of contingency reserve.

articleTitle: Problems and improvements of the evaluation method of tax burden of logistics industry in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the evaluation method of tax burden in the traditional industry and discovers the defects and misunderstandings. According to Marxist Political Economics, specifically to its theory on social average profit rate, a new evaluation method of tax burden of logistics industry - the difference among the profit analysis methods, is proposed. Based on this new method, this paper makes calculation of tax burden of logistics industry, and makes an conclusion that the tax burden is relatively high, compared to the margin profit status.

articleTitle: The design and implement of China-Japan-South Korea logistics information platform based on information service exchange
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, trade and logistics among the three countries, the demand for establishment of the China-Japan-South Korea logistics information platform (CJK-LIP) is more and more urgent. This paper analyzes the requirements of the platform, proposes the overall design idea, and discusses critical technique problems in the platform development and implement. The proposed design method was successfully applied in the construction of CJK-LIP. Application effect of CJK-LIP show that CJP-LIP based on information service exchange will be a valuable model for international logistics information platform construction.

articleTitle: The spatial transformation mechanism of Beijing Songzhuang Cultural and Creative Industry Zone: A perspective of production of space
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Beijing Songzhuang Cultural and Creative Industry Zone (hereinafter referred to as Songzhuang Art Zone) was originally a small village in the rural area of southeastern Beijing, which was chosen by some painters as their resident place in the 1990s for its lower rents and peaceful environment. Now it has grown into a famous commercial zone of original arts and culture in China. Its tremendous transformation from a peripheral village to an official artistic zone in the recent more than twenty years can be considered, to some extent, a process of production of space. With the theory of Henri Lefebvre as the framework, the production process of the physical space, social space and creative space of the zone is examined and the mechanism behind the evolution of the space is revealed from the perspectives of capital and power. It is found that the development of Songzhuang Art Zone is essentially a dynamic game manipulated by capital and power among the three players, namely, the physical space, the social space and the creative space, of which, the physical space naturally serves as the basis. Specifically, the spatial development of the zone is strongly molded by capital and power on the one hand, while on the other, it is taking on a homogeneous form, for the spatial production of the zone is operated under the principle of making profits due to the profit-driven nature of capital. Consequently, the production of heterogeneous space, particularly distinctive space of its own, should be emphasized as a key to improving the competiveness of Songzhuang Art Zone.

Author Keywords: Songzhuang Cultural and Creative Industry Zone

articleTitle: The research on internal game of enterprise based on game theory and analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of economy, market competition is increasingly fierce. In order to reduce the cost of logistics, many companies hope to outsource logistics service. However, for the choice of third party logistics companies, the departments within the enterprise also face various game. To solve this issue, the paper will use analytic hierarchy process to get the model parameters, which is on the basis of establishing the Nash equilibrium model. Finally, the enterprise is able to make a choice intuitively by comparing relevant data.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of grape wine quality based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to select the better wine grape varieties, and improve wine quality evaluation standards, the paper made a cluster analysis of wine grape samples based on the selected 57 physicochemical indexes. It's also classified different categories of wine grape after comparing the results of the wine quality evaluation. SPSS for canonical correlation analysis was used to find typical indicators, which reflect the comprehensive level of wine grape and wine physicochemical indexes. Matlab was used to establish BP three layer neural network, which reflects the relationship among the comprehensive score of wine and typical indexes of grape wine and wine grape. Through the analysis and test on the model, consistent rate reached 100% which proves the model to be available. So we can use the model with physical and chemical indexes of the grape and wine to quantify the quality of wine according to the corresponding training function.

articleTitle: Automated warehouse storage assignment policy based on storage frequency and workload balance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Storage assignment policy will directly affect the order-picking efficiency and logistics cost in an automated warehouse. Based on the traditional storage assignment policies which are focused on the storage frequency, we take workload balance into consideration and propose two new storage assignment policies for the automated warehouse. By analyzing and calculating, it is discovered that new storage assignment policy can effectively reduce roadway congestion, improve the warehouse workload balance and the operation efficiency.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of the supply situation of Chinese medicine service system in hubei province
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The policy of the traditional Chinese medicine was researched in this paper. Firstly, the stages of Chinese medicine policy since 1949 were introduced. Secondly, the characteristics and advantages of the traditional Chinese medicine in Hubei province were studied. Thirdly, the policy measures and economic indicators of Hubei province were compared with other provinces. Fourthly, the problems which Hubei confronted with to develop Chinese medicine were analyzed. Fifthly, the conclusions were drawn. According to this paper, in order to fully play the role of Chinese medicine for the public's health and promote the development of the traditional Chinese medicine in Hubei, national government should increase heavy investment for developing the Chinese medicine industry. And provincial health department should implement the government's preferential policies to the prosperity of the state hospital for Chinese medicine. Then the medical institutions should be encouraged to provide the service and technology of the traditional Chinese medicine. In addition, the service capabilities of Chinese medicine should be strengthened and improved.

articleTitle: Analysis on the formation of the third party logistics strategic alliance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the fast development of logistics in our country, the competition between logistics companies becomes more and more fierce. In order to adapt to the change of environment, the third party logistics strategic alliance becomes a necessary trend. The strategic alliances and third party's logistics all have been studied more in the management science domain nowadays. In the realistic meaning, strategic alliance can improve the enterprise's performance obviously through the optimization of supply and cooperation of enterprises, and third party logistics can strengthen the key business and the competitiveness themselves through wrapping up to logistics outside. Strategic alliance is a new competition pattern of era of economy. Choosing a right cooperative partner possibly decides the fate of the majority of strategic alliances. High speed rail express is a good example to introduce strategic alliance. The reason to form strategic alliance and how to form strategic alliance are very important. What is more, the collaboration partner selection plays an important role in strategic alliance. Finally, we present a case where using AHP method to select the most suitable collaboration partner.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the impact of economic value added on capital structure of listed company in information technology industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council has adopted EVA(Economic Value Added) to assess the performance of state-owned enterprises, which suggests that the significance and advantage of using EVA as a performance evaluation indicator is increasingly prominent. Besides, capital structure is an important factor influencing enterprise value, optimizing capital structure can enhance enterprise value. However, EVA includes the cost of capital, so the relationship between the two has become a problem worthy of study. This paper selected 106 listed companies in IT(Information Technology) industry in the period of 2011-2014, formed the sample of unbalanced panel date, empirical researched the relationship between economic value added and its capital structure. The empirical results showed that: EVA does affect the formation of capital structure in IT industry, but the degree is hysteretic and not great. Also, the conclusion can help regulators and investors to predict the behavior of enterprises and investment risk.

articleTitle: Evaluation of supply capacity of food emergency logistics in natural disaster
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In China, natural disasters which are regionalism, diversity, frequency, extensive losses greatly threaten the people's personal safety and property security. However, some circumstances could exist in affected areas, such as shortage and invalid supply of emergency food, competition for materials among people and so forth. In this paper, we study on supply capacity of food emergency logistics, establish a corresponding evaluation index system, and use intuitionistic fuzzy analytic hierarchy process to make a comprehensive evaluation. Then we can put forward a method of testing the supply capacity of food emergency logistics in response to natural disasters. The results help to explore the problems existing in the supplies of emergency food.

articleTitle: Integrated platform for smart traffic big data
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: City officials often lack access to data and methodologies to assist them to design urban freight policies that effectively balance the needs of citizens and consumers. This paper reviewed literature on traffic data visualization and presented some typical applications of urban logistics integrated platform with their candidate tools, then put forward the route map to process big traffic data with collaborative trends, finally integrated and illustrated with real traffic data grabbed from the Beijing Municipal Commission of Transport.

articleTitle: Disaster risk communication practice: A comparison between the government of China and USA
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Aiming to the disaster risk communication, this paper compare the government system of China with USA to find out the strength and weakness in risk communication. The research analyzed two country's emergency management system, risk communication activities, and risk communication responsibilities. As the result of comparison research, this paper discussed the different structure between two countries, and presented advice to optimize the risk communication in China.

articleTitle: Application of information technology in cultivating college english learning motivation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Learning motivation plays an important role in college English teaching. This paper attempts to explore the application of information technology in order to solve the currently existing problem found by doing the questionnaire. Based on the theoretical explanation of the connotation and classification of learning motivation as well as the analysis of its affecting factors, two approaches have been proved effective. On one hand, making authentic learning situation by means of information technology helps to stimulate students' integrative motivation; on the other hand, emphasizing goal-driven learning approach through information technology is good to develop students' instrumental motivation. In a word, cultivating college English learning motivation by the application of information technology is of great significance to the field of college English education.

articleTitle: Method research for high-speed train operation adjustment based on Immune Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As an important part of the railway train dispatching, train operation adjustment is the key guarantee for increasing the efficiency of rail transport and improving the quality of transport service. According to the characteristics of the High-speed train operation organization, the model is set up. Immune Genetic Algorithm, which is the effective combination of the artificial immune algorithm and genetic algorithm, is adopted to solve the model. During the model solving process, the introduction of vaccination, immune operator and immune balance operator could reduce the solving blindness, guide the individual towards a better direction development, avoid the degeneracy which general evolution algorithms may encounter and improve the algorithm efficiency. Finally, according to the simulation example which is based on the background of JinQin high-speed railway, the feasibility, validity and practicability of the model and algorithm are validated.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of mentoring relationship on improving the career satisfaction of young teachers in universities and colleges — The moderating effect of gender
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Young teachers are the main force for the future development of universities and colleges. For individual young teachers, the degree of career satisfaction exerts a direct influence on their working enthusiasm. A questionnaire survey is conducted among 300 young teachers from 8 universities and colleges in China to study the relationship between mentoring relationship and the career satisfaction of young teachers in universities and colleges as well as the moderating effect of gender on such relationship. Results indicate that mentoring relationship has a significant positive effect on the career satisfaction of young teachers in universities and colleges. In addition, gender as a moderating variable moderates the relationship between mentoring relationship and young teachers' career satisfaction.

Author Keywords: young teachers in universities and colleges

articleTitle: A low carbon supply chain network equilibrium model with different product's environmental factors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, a general multitier supply chain network equilibrium model with different product's environmental factors were developed. We set a multi-criteria decision making mechanism for various decision-makers (manufacturers, retailers, and consumers among the multi-level supply chain network) such as the maximization of each decision maker's profit, the minimization of carbon emission. For the supply chain network, the governing equilibrium conditions were formulated as variational inequality. In the meantime, the algorithm, accompanied with convergence results, is then applied to numerical supply chain network examples, as well as sensitivity analysis towards different environmental factors and different environmental awareness levels.

articleTitle: Research of the competency model of classified personnel quality evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of classified personnel quality evaluation, with the aid of competency model which commonly used in human resource management and performance. The author researches on the five aspects classified personnel quality, Obtain the empirical data through questionnaire, It is concluded that the characteristics of load and variance accounted by using statistical analysis. The results showed that the classified staff competency model can be classified into five factors : Organizational identification, business ability, psychological level, security standard, comprehensive quality. Finally, the author also discusses the competency model of classified reference value for the selection and training of personnel management.

articleTitle: Subsequence pattern discovery in Chinese university financial data
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The financial data time series of a university contain important information of its resource allocation and developing trends, which can be revealed in their distinctive patterns. This work uses selective subsequence time series clustering based on motifs to discovery financial subsequence patterns in Chinese universities. The research finds out interesting patterns in eight university categories. The results can be used for guiding decision-making and forecasting the effects of decisions.

articleTitle: Service quality based passenger segmentation for city bus and service strategy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Motivation, the driver of individual behavior, is highly related to what and how people talk and behave. Segmentation is an important marketing concept in business for understanding consumer demand and for formulating marketing strategies to fulfill this demand. From this perspective, the service quality of a city bus is a pull-based motive. Moreover, empirical evidence suggests that higher service quality increases passenger loyalty. Hence, using empirical data, a service quality-based segmentation scheme is developed in this research to help segment city bus passengers on the basis of their perception of service quality. This helps to define a quality improvement strategy for different passenger segments. This study recognizes five segments: 1. a moderate quality disconfirmation segment (21.2%), 2. a slight quality disconfirmation segment (17.6%), 3. a serious quality disconfirmation segment (23.5%), 4. a moderate quality disconfirmation with serious interaction problem segment (12.2%), and 5. a moderate quality disconfirmation with serious management support problem segment (25.5%). All five service quality segments show different patterns of quality disconfirmation, which implies that the service quality of Taipei city buses needs to be improved on the basis of each segment's needs. A service quality improvement strategy is further explored for each segment.

articleTitle: Cyclic train timetabling model for high speed railway
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The cyclic train timetabling problem is studied in order to enhance the feasibility of the periodic event scheduling problem (PESP) model. First, we use the variable trip time constraints to replace the fixed trip time constraints, and the train acceleration and deceleration times are introduced into the trip time constraints. Then we provide the arrival safety constraints and departure safety constraints to take place of the original safety constraints in the PESP model. In order to reduce the solving time, we introduce a cutting plane into the new model. The proposed model is implemented using CPLEX 12.5, and the effectiveness is further examined through a case study.

articleTitle: Optimization of the steel supply chain costs
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, take China's steel enterprises as the research object, use iron and steel enterprise supply chain costs related theory research as foundation established steel enterprise supply chain cost optimization model, using goal programming method to solve the created iron and steel enterprise supply chain cost optimization model. The model will be applied to the steel enterprises, propose a supply chain cost optimization strategy, provide a reference for the future development of its business.

articleTitle: Study on inbound special goods traceability system on the basis of RFID technology
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Inbound special goods include four categories of microorganisms, biological products, and human tissue, blood and blood products, the nature of which is quite complex. Many special goods contain bacteria, viruses and other pathogens, thus some may carry pathogenicity, infectivity and some unknown natures, which could cause great harms to human beings or animals. On the basis of RFID technology, the thesis establishes a remote monitoring and traceability system of special inbound goods. It could feed back the inspection results in time and monitor the flow direction of high-risk goods flow to ensure the safety of the products. At the same time, the inspection will be carried out aiming at different goods, and the inspection result will be recorded to feed back to credit system constantly.
