articleTitle: Analytical travel time models for multi-aisle automated storage and retrieval systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Acceleration and deceleration of the AS/RS machine in automated storage and retrieval systems are considered in this paper instead of uniform speed, and there are curve channels in the warehouse. Based on the above hypothesis, the time function and distance function are studied in this paper. The distribution function of the distance and time is given. On this basis, the expected travel time of the automated storage and retrieval system is studied. Finally, a numerical example is given to draw the conclusion that this model is more practical.

articleTitle: A Research on the storage strategy of university apartment spare parts based on the stochastic inventory model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The management of student apartments is an important part of the rear-service in universities. Under the trend of rear-service socialization reform, it is essential to control the inventory cost of the spare parts in student apartments. But the function of apartment management system at present mainly lies in simple recording and summarizing. Therefore, it is in need of corresponding inventory model to improve the intelligence of system and provide decision support for managers. This paper used the strategy of (s, S), took the minimum cost as the objective function, and established inventory management model based on stochastic demand and stochastic lead time. After that, it classified the spare parts into 4 categories according to the characteristics of demand and the degrees of importance, and established safety stock management system under the constraint of different service levels. Finally, a computational example was presented to illustrate the efficiency and applicability of the model, which can provide a reference value for the practical problems in the management of university apartment inventory.

articleTitle: Matching the supply of and demand for logistics talent: An investigation in northeast of China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The paper aims to find out the factors leading to mismatch between the demand of and current supply of the logistics talents in northeast China and propose suggestions to the problem. We use investigation, questionnaire and modified Quality Function Deployment (QFD) methods. Firstly, an index system of enterprises demands for logistics talents and graduates supply by using Business, Logistics and Management (BLM) is found by collecting data from investigation and questionnaires. Secondly, a house of quality is formed between the enterprise demand and graduates supply. Eventually, the method shows what key factors of the mismatches are. Mismatches are showed in quantity, education, gender and abilities. Salary, working place, education and skills are the key factors affect mismatch. The enterprises' prospective and graduates' perspective are different. Universities and colleges' training couldn't meet the enterprises actual demands.

articleTitle: Logistics capabilities of cement transport firm: Towards an understanding of capabilities portfolio
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Drawing on the resource-based view (RBV), this study explores the capabilities portfolio of logistics service providers (LSPs) and sustainable competitive advantage. Cement transportation, as a kind of logistics services are selected, and the research model are built to analyze the portfolio of transport capabilities. Results show that different service strategies produce different impact on capability portfolio. Determine a reasonable portfolio of internal and external logistics capabilities is the important factor for cost control.

articleTitle: Granger causality relationship between automobile sales volume and income of urban residents
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Granger causality analyses aim to reveal the direction of influence between brain areas by analyzing temporal precedence: if a signal change in area A consistently precedes a signal change in area B, then A Granger-causes B. China is a country with a great quantity of automobile production and usage. With the rapid development of economy, the demand of our country's automobile is in a state of sustained growth. China is one of the fastest growing economies in the world, and the automobile production and sales volume has been ranked NO.1 in the world. The impact of China's automobile production and sales of internal factors has been widely concerned. Granger causality is the representative of the method which is the use of large sample data for a long period of time. The relationship between income and car sales is studied. But in fact, with the characteristics of different stages of the development of China's economy, the relationship between income and car sales is very different. Through the analysis of the causal relationship of the two, it can be more able to confirm the relation between the two. And through the inspection of the lag, considering the time lag, it makes the independent variable and dependent variable reaching the height of the fitting and it is conducive to analyze the causal relationship between dependent variables.

articleTitle: Study on online music business model innovation based on value chain theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The emergence of online music has brought a great change into the music industry, it also has brought opportunities for the development of music industry. With the emergence and development of the Internet, the traditional music business model cannot adapt to the development of online music anymore, so that online music business model based on Internet thinking need to be established. Based on value chain theory, centered on Internet thinking, this article attempt to set up a new online music business models by analysis of the whole online music industry value chain and analyze the operation strategy and services mode of the business models.

articleTitle: Pricing decisions of two products with carbon emissions trading and green technology investment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we study the monopoly market two products manufacturing enterprises in carbon cap and trade policy, respectively, for carbon emissions trading decisions, green technology investment decision, carbon emissions trading and green technology investment portfolio decision three cases the optimal pricing decision. The optimal pricing combination of two product manufacturing enterprises under three conditions is presented. The research results show that the government's carbon quota will have an important impact on the optimal pricing policy of manufacturing enterprises, carbon emissions trading and green technology investment can optimize and improve the pricing decisions of enterprises to a certain extent.

articleTitle: A research on empty container allocation problem
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Container transportation is a significant guarantee to the realization of many international trades and playing a significant role in the transactions across borders. Empty container allocation and management relate to the degree of container utilization, the cost of empty container disposition expenses, adaptation for containers of goods sent in a timely manner and enterprise economic benefits. Through rational empty container allocation, you can reduce transportation costs under the premise of meeting the heavy container of normal transportation. At last, we could help shipping companies minimize the cost and maximize profits. Under the background of multimodal transport, this article consider of the lowest cost of the empty container allocation and minimal time of total deviation as the goal, establishing a bi-objective programming model. And through the mathematical programming software Lingo, the model is followed by a numerical example, which shows that this model is feasible.

articleTitle: Vegetable price fluctuations estimated effect on consumer welfare
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In view of the change of vegetable price caused the change of consumer welfare effect. We using compensation variable model analyzing the changes of short-term welfare and long-term welfare for consumer(urban residents and rural residents) between 1998 to 2013,which caused by the vegetable price fluctuation. According to the analysis results, some suggestions are put forward to improve consumer welfare.

articleTitle: Psychological contract's mediating effect between psychological capital and job burnout
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper establishes a relation model between psychological capital and job burnout by taking psychological contract as an intervening variable, so as to discuss psychological capital's impact on job burnout. According to research results, psychological capital has an evident negative correlation with job burnout; and psychological contract plays a certain mediating role in the relation between psychological capital and job burnout. Research results show that psychological contract is vital for psychological capital that has an impact on job burnout. Intervention evidence for job burnout is found through psychological capital's logical excavation and demonstration on the impact mechanism of job burnout. This has important significance for the prevention and relief of job burnout of staff.

articleTitle: Analysis and prevention of construction contract risk management based on the contractors' interests
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Project construction is a kind of highly risk industry. Risk is inherent in construction projects of all types and sizes. It has many causes and its effects manifest themselves in various forms. Most recognizable are impacts on the schedule, where they reduce float, and its flexibility to absorb delays and thus mitigate risk. Regardless of the nature of risk, it is measurable by its effect. The project items features complexity, changeability, timeliness cause the risks to it contract, and market, society, policy surely have a closely influence on it. This paper claims that the risks may be encountered during the execution of the contract for the project contract, and puts forward some suggestions for the risk management.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between the team commitment, knowledge sharing and performance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Unlike most of the empirical analysis, this paper applies netlogo multi agent simulation software to explore the complex and dynamic relationship between team commitment, knowledge sharing and performance. Combined with related parametric evolution curves, concluding: teams with higher level of commitment have bigger scale and higher total output, average level of output and level of effort decrease with the increase of exaggerated commitment value.

articleTitle: Frequent patterns discovery and analysis granularity recognition for Shanghai Composite Index sequence
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Shanghai Composite Index is a typical time series, and reflects the stock market variations. In this paper, a method is proposed for mining frequent patterns from the Shanghai Composite Index using the agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm based on DTW. For reflecting the nature of research question and reducing the computational complexity, the best time granularity is found by effective evaluation based on the clustering results.

articleTitle: Operation support of Beijing metro automatic fare collection system clearance house system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Metro has been proved to be the most efficient public urban transportation way. To support daily operation, Clearance house system of auto fare collection (AFC) system should be operated continuously. Beijing metro introduces operation support for clearance house system. Then the thesis elaborates general goal, basic approach, scope, frame work and key performance indicator of operation support. After 7 years practice, it is proved to be suitable operation support for Beijing metro.

articleTitle: The quantity prediction of 4G customers of China mobile communications corporation based on SPSS modeler
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> Century, China's mobile communications has a huge space for development. The emergence of independent of the 4th generation mobile communication technology provides an unprecedented opportunity for the development of China's mobile communications. As the world's largest telecom operator, China Mobile Communications Corporation has become the leader of promoting China's 4th generation mobile communication mobile communications system. In this paper, we use three methods of time series prediction, which are provided by SPSS Modeler, to predict the number of each month's customers of the 4th generation mobile communication during March to September, 2016, and evaluate the models.

articleTitle: Revenue-sharing contract for supply chain under a Cap and Trade system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the carbon emission Cap and Trade system, this paper constructs a single supply chain system which consists of one manufacturer and one exclusive retailer. The manufacturer's self-purifying technology investment and consumer low-carbon preference are all modeled. We reveal how to coordinate the supply chain by a revenue-sharing contract under the Cap and trade frame. The results indicate that the revenue-sharing contract can coordinate the supply chain and achieve the total supply chain's profit maximization. The feasible retailer revenue share range which makes every supply chain member better off depends on self-purifying efficiency, carbon emission trade price and consumer low-carbon preference pressure significantly.

articleTitle: Carbon emission research of Beijing transportation system based on SD
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the fierce increasing of population, prospect for air condition in Beijing is overwhelmingly negative. Transportation takes a great part in the total carbon emissions and the percentage keeps going up. In this paper, a Beijing transportation system model is built using System Dynamics and four sub-systems are considered which are cars, bus, taxies and subway transportation sub-systems. After that, simulation of the system in three different scenarios is made to compare the different effects. It turns out that the carbon emissions of car system is the major part of total transportation carbon emissions. Therefore, methods to reduce car carbon emissions should be developed to produce an effective progress of air condition like reducing the amount of cars or cutting down the energy consumption of cars.

articleTitle: An empirical research on the relationship of equity incentive and performance of Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: At present, to improve their businesses and obtain more profits by enhancing enterprise competitiveness, more and more listed companies have been committed to the selection of executives and the study of motivation. Among the many forms of incentives, stock-based compensation play a vitally important role. Many scholars abroad did survey on the relationship between equity incentive and corporate performance, but so far they didn't reach same conclusion. Considering that option incentive system is far from perfect, particularly in our own, there is not definite answer to the question. So, in order to study how the management stock position proportion influence the corporate performance, this paper takes listed companies that have implemented stock-based stimulation between 2012 and 2015 as the research object.

articleTitle: Behavior simulation of “Chinese style road crossing” based on evolutionary game theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper aims at studying the changes in the number of pedestrians who go across road in “Chinese ways” to discover the evolution laws and behavior influential factors. The model including pedestrians crossing behavior analysis without supervising are established, and the profit matrix is acquired by intercepting the scene of “Chinese style road crossing”. The influence of variety of decision-making parameters on evolution is discussed. The effect of variety of revenue and loss of ordinary pedestrian and adventure illegal pedestrian, and the effect of changing initial condition on the evolution results are shown by numerical simulation. It is found that “Chinese style road crossing” may not only evolve to good state, but also evolve to bad state, and forms “lock in” convergence state of behavior is dependent on relative payment of various tactics between ordinary pedestrian and adventure illegal pedestrian. Evolutionary routes for “Chinese style road crossing” can be optimized and guide the adventure illegal behavior making for the good direction.

articleTitle: Study on China's rapid rescue system of natural disasters emergency logistics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper describes the concept and characteristics of natural disaster emergency logistics and points out China's three core problems, including emergency resources, information integration analysis and coordinative command. In order to solve the existing problems, a natural disaster emergency logistics rapid rescue system containing information, storage, command and delivery is proposed after deep analysis.

articleTitle: Research on bus travel decision system based on generalized cost calculation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper designed a bus travel decision-making system including two sub-module: bus line querying module and optimal travel program choosing module which based on generalized cost calculation. This system can provide different optimal travel scheme recommendations when the time value of residents, bus travel speed and overcrowding situation are differing during the non-peak time and peak time. The minimum generalized cost is 8.89 yuan for direct program in non-peak time, while 9.57 yuan for transfer program in peak time, so this decision-system can provide optimal travel suggestion under real-time traffic state.

articleTitle: Research on the policy of the development of railway transportation industry based on value chain
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Railway is the important national infrastructure and livelihood projects, it is a resource-saving and environment-friendly mode of transportation, and it is of great significance to speed up the development of railway. Under the situation of railway investment and financing reform, to promote development of railway should not only play a decisive role of market, but also should analysis railway construction chain and business chain from the perspective of value chain in order to exert the role of government in guidance promoting. Multiple fields of construction of both central and local levels, and use the analysis methodology of GRA to determine the factors affecting the railway transportation industry policy, and study investment, construction, transportation management policy system to improve the railway investment and financing policy, create good environment to promote sustained and healthy development of railway.

articleTitle: An integrated approach for sustainable container supply chain design and evaluation — A simulation approach with case study
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Traditionally, the container is usually regarded as a `black box' in container supply chain design and analysis, which ignores the interactions between container, inner packaging and logistics operations and their impact on sustainability performance of the logistics solution. But according to UK and international insurance organisations, more than half of incidents in container shipping are cargo loss or damage, and more than one third of those value loss incidents are contributed by poorly or incorrect packed containers. Since the packaging related factors are tightly related to container cargo value loss in logistics operations and further influence the sustainability of the container supply chain, this paper introduces packaging logistics concept and risk management tools into container shipping to integrate the packaging, cargo and logistics operation as a holistic system in container supply chain evaluation and design. An integrated framework and approach is proposed in this paper for sustainable container supply chain evaluation and design taking packaging related risks into account. And simulation model is developed to apply this integrated method in container shipping scenario.

articleTitle: Technology innovation risk identification based on sequential CBR
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: To identify risks in the increasingly complex market is an important issue related to the survival and development of technology innovation enterprises. In front of diversified and massive risk sources, it is an inevitable choice for technology innovation enterprises to utilize IT to support the risk identification task. Case-Based Reasoning(CBR) is an analogical reasoning based AI method, and can help enterprises to identify new risks from past technology innovation risk cases, but have limitations for the problems with dynamic characteristics. Under this background, we study the sequential CBR method for technology innovation risk identification in the work, where cases are represented as risk event sequences and the case similarity measuring method based on weighted event sequence pattern mining is proposed. Finally the effectiveness of the method is demonstrated by a risk identification case.

articleTitle: Keep the products fresh: A QFD approach to improve the logistics service quality of cold chain
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With people's increasing requirements for fresh products, how to improve logistics service quality becomes a key issue for logistics service provider. The cold chain logistics service provided by the enterprises varies considerably in quality. Considering the diversification of consumer requirements, logistics service providers see customer satisfaction as the important decision factors. This paper introduces a method of quality function deployment (QFD) to discuss the service quality of cold chain logistics for fresh products, which will provide a better way to meet the customer requirements. Firstly, an index system of customer requirements for fresh products is found using analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Secondly, based on the internal service of enterprise, an index system of service technology is built. Then, a house of quality (HOQ) is formed through the establishment of correlation matrix between the customer requirements and service technology. Eventually, the method is applied in a company, translating the elusive customer requirements into corrective actions.

articleTitle: Research on dairy supply chain traceability system and its pre-warning model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Through designing a traceability system of dairy supply chain based on a mixed traceability mode, which can be used to horizontal and vertical two dimensions query. According to the DHI report, HACCP analysis of dairy processing and relevant national standard, the pre-warning indexes of various links of the supply chain, and the pre-warning model based on BP neural network method can be established on the basis of traceability system.

articleTitle: The relationship between company performance and executive compensation of construction industry state-owned listed companies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Since the separation of ownership and management in companies, senior managers as the company's core decision-making, their pay is directly linked to company performance. In this paper takes the construction industry as its object of study, selecting total assets net profit margin, return on equity, earnings per share, total assets, asset-liability ratio indicators which can measure the company performance of state-owned listed companies, analysing the correlation between executive compensation and corporate performance by SPSS regression analysis, and provide reference for improving the construction industry executive pay incentives.

articleTitle: Resident's consumer demand, government assignment and development of urban agricultural products logistics — Based on the data of agricultural products market in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the theory of logistics management, urban planning and evolutionary economics, this study selects agricultural products market in Beijing as the main research object, and explores the relationship among resident's consumer demand, government assignment and development of urban agricultural products logistics. This research appears to find, (1) there is a positive correlativity between resident's consumer demand and development of urban agricultural products logistics, (2) as an adjustment variable, government assignment can change the speed and direction of development of urban agricultural products logistics, (3) the evolution of agricultural products logistics is a co-evolution process of market and government assignment. This paper enriches the empirical study of urban agricultural products logistics, as well as provides the necessary theoretical reference for government to assign agricultural products logistics.

articleTitle: Simulation research on educational management services of college students based on the system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The fundamental purpose of educational management services is to support and ensure college students' growth and development. However, this kind of development is a complex, dynamic and accumulative system involved in all aspects. From the perspective of the dynamic system, four-dimensional theory of educational management services has been established, which consists of school education, social environment, development security, cyberspace. Based on the causal relationship of the theoretical model, the system dynamics method has been applied to put forward the simulation model aiming to analyze the relationship between investments of students' educational management services and their development. Simulation results agree well with the theoretical model, and specific strategies to improve the management services are proposed.

articleTitle: Dynamic online consumer trust forming mechanism research based on Beijing, China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This research identifies a number of key factors related to online consumer trust and establishes a model based on the System Dynamic method to find out the relationships between these factors and trust. This paper provides several contributions. Firstly it reviews the previous works of online trust and identifies the major online trust building factors which mainly consists of business factors, consumer factors, commodities factors, and e-commerce environment factors. Secondly, it builds an online consumer trust forming mechanism model based on the analysis of literature reviews. Thirdly, the causal relationship between the forming factors and consumer trust was analyzed by the simulation of system dynamic method.

articleTitle: Study on appreciation strategy of meat cold chain in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the continuous development of economy and the issue of “the 12<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Five-Year Plan” Agricultural Products Cold Chain Logistics Development Planning, the development of cold chain has achieved unprecedented attentions. The appreciation of meat cold chain is the most prominent, which is restricted by the factors of “chain scission” of cold chain, the lack of the guarantee on meat food safety, high operation cost, sole circulation and operation mode, and unbalanced resource distribution. In order to realize the continuous, rapid and healthy development of meat cold chain in China, the Agricultural Products Quality and Safety Law should be comprehensively implemented to strengthen establishment of the legal norm, supporting system and related standards of meat cold chain, actively introduce and utilize meat cold chain new technology and set up the whole course visual monitoring and retrospect “from the field to the dining-table”. Carry out meat intensive processing, create the brand effect, actively develop meat cold chain circulation pattern of various forms, and establish national meat cold chain collaborative e-business platform to realize the appreciation of meat cold chain, increase enterprise revenue and enhance competitiveness.

Author Keywords: national meat cold chain collaborative e-business platform

articleTitle: The relationship between the quality of accounting information disclosure and the liquidity — Based on the NEEQ market
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As an important financing platform for small and medium-sized enterprises, the NEEQ market has being developed quickly in the past two years and the market scale has expanded rapidly. A few days ago, the news that the promotion of the strategic emerging board will be suspended implies that the NEEQ market will usher in its tremendous opportunity. However, in terms of the current situation, the NEEQ market is short of liquidity. As an important link between corporates and investors, information disclosure has a great impact on financing and liquidity. Especially for the NEEQ market who actually take the registration-based stock-issuing system. Under the registration system, the supervision department does not examine the substance of the information disclosed by the company, thus strengthening the enterprises' autonomy of information disclosure. Therefore, exploring the relationship between the quality of accounting information disclosure and the liquidity under the NEEQ market environment is helpful to improve the liquidity problem from the micro level, and promote enterprises to improve the quality of information disclosure voluntarily, and then promoting the improvement of the information disclosure condition of the whole market.

Author Keywords: the quality of accounting information disclosure

articleTitle: Online consumer's optimal purchasing decisions under contingent free delay shipping
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper considers the optimal purchasing decisions of a consumer when online retailers provide contingent free shipping service under delay delivery. A consumption decision model for online consumers is proposed by establishing net consumption surplus function under delay delivery, which comprehensively considering all of the conditions including the product price, delay time, free shipping threshold given by online retailers, as well as the consumer's individual characteristics relate to the preference for the product and sensitivity on delay delivery, which can be used to analyze the best purchasing decisions of an online consumer. Finally, a numerical example proves the reliability of the model, and the result shows that a consumer's optimal purchasing decisions mainly depend on the comparison of free shipping cut off level under delay delivery and consumer's specific parameter about the preference for the product and sensitivity on delay time. Simultaneously, it indicates that free delay shipping service with a reasonable threshold could attract additional consumers with middle consumption desire to enlarge purchasing amount, which can be used as a reference for online retailers to set an effective free delay shipping strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between work value and work performance of online sales staff
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the times of big data, online sales staff become increasingly important with E-business generally replacing entity selling. The study takes online sales staff as research objects, raises hypotheses and a conceptual model based on literature review and makes a deep analysis of the relationship between the work value of online sales staff and the work performance. The results reveal that the work value of online sales staff is positively correlative with the job performance and can predict the job performance to some degree. The individual variables have an effect on the work values.

articleTitle: Allocation of carbon emission abatement target and pricing in a supply chain with two retailers and government subsidy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the deterioration of environment, the government and the companies which have strong consciousness of environmental protection make sure their own emissions reduction targets to reduce the emissions of CO2. In addition, the government also introduced all kinds of subsidy policies to encourage the industry to reduce the emissions of CO2. For companies, they often tend to cooperate with their upstream and downstream enterprises in the supply chain to achieve emission reduction targets. This paper considers duopolistic retailers and a manufacturer who is the leader in the game, including three scenarios: (i) the manufacturer is the allocator of carbon emission abatement target and the two retailers are competitive; (ii) the manufacturer is the allocator of carbon emission abatement target and the two retailers are cooperative; (iii) the two retailers are cooperative and the cooperative retailers are allocators. This paper investigates the optimal decisions of retailers and manufacturer in the three scenarios.

articleTitle: Fuzzy evaluation modeled risk assessment of Colleges and Universities' Sci-tech Innovation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Risk, existing in various forms during the process of Colleges and Universities' Sci-tech Innovation (CUSTI): the project application period, the project development period and the achievement transformation period, is a vital reason that restricts the innovation at colleges and universities. Fuzzy evaluation model is constructed and empirically operated based on the characteristics of CUSTI's achievement transformation period, which realizes the scientific analysis and measurement.

articleTitle: Storage optimization for export containers based on generalized delivery sequence
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Extra reshuffling may occur when lifting containers up for loading onto ships. One way to improve loading efficiency is to optimize the container storage strategy in order to fit the loading sequence. This paper proposes a two-stage algorithm to solve for a better storage strategy. The optimization goal is to minimize the number of container reshuffling operations. In the first stage, Markov forecast is applied to obtain a generalized delivery sequence, and then GA (Genetic Algorithm) is developed to solve the sequence-based model. And in the second stage, a heuristic algorithm is used to obtain a real-time storage proposal. Several sets of experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and practicability of the model and the algorithm by means of the comparison with the storage plan from exact solution and actual rules.

articleTitle: The situation and development research of internet finance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Internet finance is not clearly defined by widely accepted. With the rapid development and mature of Internet finance, people's awareness and understanding of its connotation is gradually deepened. Internet finance is a combination of Internet and finance, which is using the Internet and mobile communications technology. Internet finance is a new financial model of joining the financing, payment and information agent together. In essence, the Internet is the use of large financial data, cloud computing, social networking and other Internet search engine technology for financing a new financial services model. Internet finance both non-financial institutions as Internet companies engaged in financial operations, including financial institutions conduct business via the Internet. Internet and financial depth of integration is the further trend, which has a more profound impact on financial products, business, organization and services. Promote the healthy development of Internet finance will help enhance the quality of financial services and efficiency, deepen financial reform, promote financial innovation and development, thus can expand domestic and the financial sector to build multi-level financial system. The paper will discuss the financial situation of the Internet, and then give the future prospects and possible directions of Internet finance based on the core issue-depth analysis.

articleTitle: Tangshan iron and steel manufacturing equipment update time point of economic analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In daily work, frequently related to large-scale manufacturing equipment update problem, How to solve equipment problems is very important. The reasonable renewal of equipment is an important subject to the technical transformation of steel plant and the feasibility of promoting technological progress. This paper introduces the principle and method of system analysis and decision making, and Tangshan steel equipment renewal decision for example through case analysis and comparison of economic analysis, for equipment renewal decision providing a theoretical and practical basis.

articleTitle: Relationship of trade and China's logistics capability under “the belt and road”
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the value of import and export and logistics capability evaluating index, this paper has researched the relationship of import and export trade and China's logistics capability. Meanwhile, elastic coefficients of index have also been calculated. The value of import and export trade and China's logistics capability are used to complete status analysis. The correlation between import and export trade and logistic capability evaluating index has been analyzed. SSPS 21.0 software is applied in this section. Elastic coefficients of index reveal that import and export trade and logistics development has a positive correlation, port throughput above sea scale, Internet access ports, and container port traffic are three areas can promote volume of trade mostly.

articleTitle: Institutional review of China's M&A policy and an analysis on its effectiveness: With iron & steel industry as example
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: First, this paper reviews the M&A policy for iron & steel industry in China, then evaluates the effectiveness of M&A policy based on meso-industry data and micro-data According to this paper, the M&A policies promulgated in China failed to reduce excess production capacity, promote technical progress and improve industry profitability. Finally, this paper puts forward a suggestion on the scope of application, principles, goals and orientations of M&A policy.

articleTitle: The evaluation on resource configuration of telecom assets
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Telecom regulatory departments issued many policies to keep the healthy development of telecom assets market, while the governments pay little attention to the resource configuration of telecom assets, and some of the existing researches have not got verified in academia. In this paper, firstly it puts forward the evaluation model for resource configuration of telecom assets, and indicators of cause and outcome are considered in this model; secondly, the data of provinces, municipalities and autonomous regions in China is collected related to the evaluation indicators of resource configuration in telecom assets; and then PCA method is developed to take empirical researches on configuration evaluation of telecom assets. Thus, the overall resource configuration of telecom assets can be got quantitatively. At last, some important conclusions are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the comprehensive material flow index of logistics enterprise based on sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the material flow theory and comprehensive logistics theory, this paper analyzes the sustainable development principle of comprehensive logistics, and then establish the ESN-DSR structural model of logistics enterprise sustainable comprehensive logistics based on DSR model. On this basis, the paper puts forward the index system of logistics enterprise comprehensive logistics index, and carries on the empirical analysis.

Author Keywords: index system of comprehensive material flow index

articleTitle: Will CSR pay in the financial sector? An empirical study of a commercial bank's CSR orientation, corporate reputation and customer loyalty in western China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With globalization, commercial banks are facing increasingly strong competition, and their success now depends less on their hard power, but more on such soft powers as product ideas and moral orientation. Consequently, how to win customer with higher service quality, and to maintain and enlarge customer groups, becomes a central issue for them. By way of a customer questionnaire, this paper investigates the relationship between commercial bank's CSR orientation, reputation and customer loyalty. By analyzing a sample of 216 customers from a commercial bank's 12 sub-branches in western China, the paper finds that a commercial bank's CSR orientation is significantly correlated to its reputation and customer loyalty, and that its reputation mediates CSR orientation's impact on its customer loyalty. To realize a differentiated competition, commercial banks are advised to better concentrate on their CSR efforts, and engage in such sustainable efforts as social enterprise, green finance and sustainable finance, so as to enhance their reputation and customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Research on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of secret-related personnel qualification assessment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper begins with analyzing the current situation of China's security management, elaborates the importance of determining secret-related personnel and management. On the current status of secret-related personnel qualification job analysis, in-depth qualification of secret-related personnel and management to achieve the inquiry, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method applied to specific secret-related personnel qualification comprehensive assessment study, with the current status quo will assess confidentiality models may be divided into a number of indicators, secret-related personnel to achieve the qualification assessment level comprehensive evaluation. On this basis put forward some suggestions on the appointment of secret-related personnel selection and appointment.

articleTitle: A multi-stage location problem in route construction project management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, the location problem with route demand is motivated by route construction projects such as railway and cable constructions. The construction activities are along a route and the demand continuous function along the route will be put into the p-median location model. Stones are indispensable materials in railway construction, so that we considered a multi-stage location problem when we determine where to build both the quarry and batching facilities to achieve the process of stone mining and concrete mixing.

articleTitle: The mode of cultivating clothing talents for service-oriented production
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The clothing industry is entering the service-oriented production phase, so colleges or universities should adjust their personnel training systems to meet the needs of the growing service element. This paper presents an analysis of the clothing industry characteristics, including the deepening service depth, the staggered integration services sectors, and the dynamic and changing service alliance. Based on the analysis of the process of service-oriented production, the mode of cultivating clothing talents of colleges or universities clothing professionals facing service-oriented production are put forward, which include raising the service awareness, improving the service knowledge, and upgrading the service ability. It could be the theoretical reference for clothing higher education and personnel training.

articleTitle: Research on building financial sharing services mode of construction enterprise
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The core of enterprise management is financial management, and the characteristics of enterprise group determine the feature of its financial management. This paper introduces the concept and characteristics of Financial Shared Services Center and summarizes the features of the construction industry on financial management, and then based on the characteristics of the construction enterprises and the problems existing in current financial management to propose the type of Financial Shared Center. The purpose is to provide useful experience for construction enterprises so that they can raise the level of financial information management.

articleTitle: A study of distribution service modularity based on mass customization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Currently, with the development of global services economy and service organizations, the applications of modularity have exceeded the popular utility of Western business organizational design in the 1990s. It is increasingly combined with the actual operation of the service enterprise. Mass customization has become one of widespread service production modes. As an important part of modern logistics service, distribution service also needs to break through the traditional mode of large-scale service and combine the new service idea for extension and exploration in the rapidly changing market environment. Hence, referring to the previous research, this study integrates mass customization and service modularity idea to discuss distribution service modularity based on mass customization. This paper firstly defines the concept of distribution service based on mass customization, and then the paper summarizes the modular mechanism. The division and configuration method of distribution service based on mass customization is the last part.

articleTitle: Income distribution of vehicle logistics alliance based on principal-agent theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, using the principal-agent theory, on the basis of the alliance income distribution influencing factors analysis, establish the income distribution model. Describe the assumptions of the model, and the focus is the chief and the leaguer enterprise correlation coefficient evaluation and selection were determined discussion. And thus information symmetry and information asymmetry operating results were compared and found in the case of asymmetric information, the alliance effort level will drop, the union gains also relatively decline. And assign the relevant parameters through the example of the definition, use examples and verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Pricing and collection effort decisions in supply chain with product remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper investigates pricing and collection effort decisions under the different channel structure. In our model, we consider the collection effort impacts both remanufacturer's collection quantity and market demand. We build four game models and give the corresponding equilibrium decisions. Through comparing these equilibrium results, we find that the manufacturer (remanufacturer)'s profit is highest when the manufacturer (remanufacturer) is a Stackelberg leader, while that is smallest under Nash model and the total profit of supply chain under the centralized case is always highest.

articleTitle: A study on the business services network node optimization of integration
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the development of urban and rural integration, for supermarkets and retail enterprises in China production base management is becoming more and more attention, but the mode of operation needs to be improved. For supermarket, commercial logistics distribution center and production base of integration, how to do between nodes is of great significance to the development of our country business enterprise. This paper only select logistics distribution center, supermarket outlets, production base and other business services network node has carried on the simple analysis of the optimization. In this paper to be the time business logistics distribution center location model; In this paper from the production base to the distribution center of transport routes, transport route optimization by TSP model; In this paper from the distribution center to supermarkets outlets, such as how to make the node optimization, was used to solve VRP model.

articleTitle: Study on the construction of teaching management system based on knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Knowledge management is the further development of management discipline. Teaching management in colleges and universities is fundamentally the management of knowledge. Building teaching management system based on knowledge management is an inevitable choice in colleges and universities. Starting with improving management execution, this article focuses on ideas and methods on the construction of teaching management system basing on knowledge management. From the meaning of knowledge management, this article builds a framework model of teaching management system and designs the five functions of teaching management system platform, introduces the implementation of teaching management system at Beijing Jiaotong University, and further makes recommendation for promoting the implementation of knowledge management in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Vehicle scheduling by freight forwarder in Collecting-Dispatching system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Collecting-Dispatching system connecting the port and its hinterland requires all the resources collaborated reasonably. Freight forwarders' business in the Collecting-Dispatching system includes booking, scheduling transport mode and carrier, consulting with port operation and so on. In short, freight forwarders are meant to provide “one-stop” service for the owners. Forwarders should make scientific vehicle scheduling plan to meet the system goal. A vehicle schedule model is established aiming at cost reduction. A numerical example solved by genetic algorithm is given to show the model is effective.

articleTitle: Robust optimization model of multi-logistics-task allocation under service time uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to reduce the multilayer supply chain logistics cost and optimize logistics integrator task allocation, this paper aiming at the uncertainty of logistics service time, a relatively robust optimization model was established by considering logistics service node soft time window constraints based on the optimal total cost. Genetic algorithm is used to solve the problem, Results show that the model reasonably solves task allocation problem for logistics service integrator with the service provider time uncertain conditions. The numerical example further verify the robust optimization model could achieve the trade-off between optimality and robustness of task allocation, and it is effective in reducing the logistics cost.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of campus E-commerce system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology and Internet, Electronic commerce has been fully applied and developed in recent years. As we know, the application model and related technologies of E-commerce are increasingly mature, E-commerce era has arrived. Campus e-commerce, relying on the campus and for the purpose of serving the teachers and students, is a new exploration of the new model of E-commerce. The establishment of campus e-commerce system can not only provide convenience for students in learning and life, but also enhance the university's management ability, improve efficiency and reduce operating costs. Furthermore, it also plays an important role in promoting the development of information technology in universities.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation model of the supply chain with the constraint of carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we study the coordination of the two-stage supply chain which composed of one manufacturer and one retailer. Based on the hypothesis that demand will increase with the increase of emission reduction rate, we develop a model in which the manufacturer takes charge of the reduction of carbon emissions, and the retailer drives revenue-sharing contract. Using vensim, the software of system dynamics, to simulate this model, we can see the relations among factors used in the supply chain model clearly. We make 4 plans to analysis the effect of the constraint of carbon emissions and revenue sharing coefficient on the profit of supply chain. Finally the optimal emission reduction rate of the manufacturer and the best revenue sharing coefficient of the retailer is concluded. This method proposed can provide references for coordinating supply chains.

articleTitle: Vehicle scheduling optimization in joint distribution considering carbon emission and customer urgency
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The joint distribution mode has become a new optimization mode of distribution at present, this paper considered the carbon emission and customer urgency in the joint distribution vehicle scheduling optimization. Carbon emission calculation was based on speed and speed became decision variable. Customer urgency was defined according to the relaxability of time window. A mixed integer programming model was established with the objective of minimizing the cost. According to the characteristics of the model, this paper designed a hybrid simulated annealing algorithm to solve the problem. The numerical experiments show that joint distribution mode is better than the single distribution mode in the total cost and carbon emissions cost. Under the same example, the optimized speed can reduce the total cost and the cost of carbon emission drastically for the two distribution modes. The main reason is that the speed can be adjusted to meet the customer time window constraint, achieving to minimize the total cost and carbon emission cost.

articleTitle: New products advance selling considering strategic customers
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Advance selling is a new business model, we study optimal advance selling inventory decision of two competing firms offering homogeneous new products on the advance selling platform considering strategic customers, we use Stackelberg and Cournot game model. This paper considers a two-period model, the first period is advance selling which is possible at a discount price, regular price or premium price, and the second period is regular selling. We show that:(1)The equilibrium inventory quantity and profits of retailer one in Stackelberg game are greater than Cournot game;(2)The equilibrium inventory quantity and profits of retailer one in Stackelberg game are smaller than Cournot game;(3)The total equilibrium inventory quantity in Stackelberg game is greater than Cournot game, the total equilibrium profits in Stackelberg game is smaller than Cournot game;(4)Strategic customers affect retailers' optimal profits and inventory quantity.

articleTitle: Risk forewarning model of freight period based on scenario merging
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Detecting risk factors during freight period and making prevention or emergency measures is very important for reducing the probability of freight delay. In literatures, the operating time of function is considered as the fatal factor which affect freight period. More time the operation occupy, more important the function. But operating time of function can't reflect primary reason which results in freight delay. In our research, we take risk factors affecting freight period into consideration. From the perspective of transit scenario, we systematically analyze risk factors, mine the relationship among risk factors, and realize the dynamic merge of different freight scenario. This method can truly reflect fundamental factors affecting the freight period. So the management of freight period forewarning can be procedural, fine and dynamic.

articleTitle: Research on the relevant issues of intellectual property management in colleges and universities
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As the main force of original innovation, the college is the source of technological innovation and the important subject in creating intellectual properties in China. In recent years, colleges in our country are paying more and more attention in intellectual property, what's more, the amount of patent application and authorization volume increased year by year. However, the colleges' management of intellectual property is still weak because the management system is not absolutely perfect and there is lack of attention on intellectual property. Therefore, strengthening the management of intellectual property is the urgent and core problem to be solved.

articleTitle: Optimal reorder decision-making under the uncertain production cost
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The long time from contracting to the producing and the stochastic price fluctuation of raw material will cause the phenomenon that the production cost is uncertain when two firms sign the contract. The uncertain cost brings about new conflicts to the supply chain. We consider a supply chain, in which the manufacturer produces the products and the retailer orders products and sells them to the customers. We first investigate the optimal decisions in centralized decision. The supply chain with wholesale price contract and the wholesale contract with reorder is then demonstrated. We prove that the reorder could coordinate the production in some circumstance with uncertain cost, and it could increase the supply chain profit a lot.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the medical logistics vehicle monitoring and management
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to solve the safety monitoring of drug in the medical logistics transportation, monitoring the vehicle position, speed and other status information, and optimization of vehicle scheduling problem, and preparing for the follow-up vehicle routing optimization, the GPS based logistics vehicle management system is researched and implemented with the Internet of things technology. This paper briefly describes the overall design framework and hierarchical model of the system, and finally the specific functions and the key technology of how to realize the function of the system are studied and the system test results are given.

articleTitle: A uniform pricing and channel selection model with random demand
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper illustrates the wholesaling price-only contract scenario where the manufacturer as a leader decides the wholesale price, and then the retailer gives his optimal retail price, marketing effort and order quantity. Using an iso-price-elastic multiplicative demand function, we could obtain the equilibrium solutions. But when demand follows linear additive function, we couldn't obtain the equilibrium solutions. Furthermore, we draw similar conclusions on manufacturers' channel selection. That is, manufacturers prefer to build direct channel only with lower channel costs, which also change retailers' profit.

articleTitle: Research on integrated management of railway engineering survey and design project
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The traditional project method of separating the survey and designing has produced a series of problems, the integrated management of the railway engineering survey and design project has become a new research field. The paper analyzes the problems in the management of the railway engineering survey and design project, and discusses the reasons about the problems before building the model of integrated management, and illustrates the feasibility of implementing the method of integrated management. In the end, the paper also puts forward the implementation method of the integrated management in order to provide reference for our survey and design enterprises.

articleTitle: Collaboration research on fresh production supply chain information system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Through the analysis of collaborative development process of supply chain and information system, this dissertation analyses how to achieve the collaboration between fresh supply chain and efficient information system. Meanwhile, it puts forward the concept of collaborative management information system of supply chain. And the paper introduces the construction scheme of the collaborative agricultural supply chain management information system. In the end, the paper makes five reasonable suggestions about material procurement, transportation, warehousing, and distribution and information system construction with respect to integrated supply information, supplier management and produce-marketing integration.

articleTitle: Game model of safety investment in mines based on utility function
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to reduce the costs and maximize the profit, many coal mining enterprises are gaming in the safety investment under the coal-mining supervision in China although relative supervision provisions are strict, which results in mine accidents happening. In order to make sense the causes that are behind the economic motivation, based on the gaming model with two variables, technology and cost, in utility function, a safety investment analysis for decision makers is conducted in this paper by focusing on the technological level and production cost in the coal mining enterprises and presenting the gaming process among these enterprises. The result is that there is no enough incentiveness in short term to conduct safety investment under the condition of low technological level in China. Therefore, it is necessary to enhance safety awareness, strengthen supervision and improve safety status of coal production.

articleTitle: Using support vector machine for online purchase predication
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: E-commerce has become a vital contributor to China's national economy. A mass of users' behavioral data on E-commerce platforms such as browse, click and purchase have being accumulated during DT era. Using machine learning algorithms to explore patterns behind big data grows into a new focus of research. In this paper, firstly, we use SQL Server to do feature extraction on those behavioral data. Secondly, Libsvm, a software package based on SVM, is used to train the features collected above to build a predicting model. Finally, we employ the model to predict the future buying conditions of online consumers and acquire a desirable outcome. Thus, to a certain extent, our study has a practical significance to discover regular patterns of online shopping as well as improve products recommendation accuracy and conversion rate of e-commerce.

articleTitle: Integration application system of Chinese wooden architecture heritages based on BIM
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Being a particular structure of ancient architecture in China, a large amount of wooden architectures were inscribed on the World Heritage List. The components can be perceived as the carriers of multivariate information which will increase and update over time in a long term. To strengthen the correlation between digital information and components of architectural entities, and meet the growing demands of the preservation of cultural relics as well, this BIM-based project integrates knowledge from different disciplines as Architecture, heritage conservation theory, logistics information and information management. It aims to build on a feasible management system of heritage units with more scientifically records, operation, maintenance, management and display by employing the building information model. Under the circumstances of a boom in computer technology and Big Data, this project attempts to bridge the gap between advanced information management and wooden-structured architectures.

articleTitle: Frontier exploration of internet thinking and case study
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Traditional enterprises should change their marketing strategy, business model, organizational structure and etc. to cope with the new market in the Internet age. Duo to the above requirement, the conception of Internet Thinking (IT) is created in China. Although many scholars have done a lot of research on this field about the company operating at the context of Internet and a few Chinese researchers begin to pay attention to Internet Thinking. The existing research focused on the specific points without a systematic view. This paper try to integrate different points of view and combine with the practice of Chinese market to figure out what is Internet Thinking. The first, some key words of Internet Thinking are extracted from literature review and practice in business world; the second, the components involved are analyzed and the definition is given; at last, the company of Xiaomi will be taken as the case to test the model.

articleTitle: A brief analysis of favorable and unfavorable conditions for future development of pharmaceutical E-commerce in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Recent years, with a great development of Chinese pharmaceutical E-commerce, many problems appeared. This article analyzed the opportunity and threaten factors of Chinese Pharmaceutical E-commerce. Chinese pharmaceutical E-commerce has huge domestic market, mature enterprises, advanced technology for its advantages; but limited hospital prescription, distribution channel problem, separated with medical insurance and competition with pharmaceutical retailing were still existed as disadvantages. Therefore, this article offered some suggestion, which may provide theoretical support for the government's pharmaceutical policy.

articleTitle: Information visualization of AIS data
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the increasing amount of Automatic Identification System, AIS data, an effective analysis method and technology for large-scale data are a challenge. Information visualization is a suitable technology for people without professional data mining knowledge, such as navigation managers and ship drivers, for understanding mass AIS data. We implement direct and summary visualization of AIS information. Visual graphs can assist in real-time monitoring of key areas, including dense areas, high-speed areas, extreme slow-down areas as well as other areas. Furthermore, visual graphs can provide identification and vessel behavior understanding and are conducive in regularizing driving behavior, recognizing key areas and improving navigation safety.

articleTitle: The backbone network optimization problem of air express: The case of China air express
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the synergetic development of express enterprises and air freight enterprises, the express enterprises in China are gradually extending their scope of business to air express. The express company does not have its own airplane, it cooperates with airlines to offer air express services. The company has established branches in China. The branch usually adopts direct transportation to complete express shipping, which means that there is no stop between the origin airport and the destination airport. As for the routes with less volume of business, they are unable to achieve economies of scale which leads to high transportation costs. Besides the huge cost problem, there are other issues such as less cooperation among branches, arbitrariness and lack of standardization in the network operation and delayed delivery. The goal of this paper is to optimize the air express backbone network formed by branches. We establish air express backbone network optimization model based on scale economics. The model takes transportation cost, time, the number of aircrafts, the interval of airplane, and transit costs between nodes into account. We also present an illustrative case study.

articleTitle: Node importance evaluation of world city networks: A survey
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The study of world city networks becomes one of the hottest research areas. Mining the important nodes has been important research questions in network evaluation of world city applications. In this paper, we firstly summarized the characteristics of world city network and evaluated their centrality and power of control. Then, the node importance evaluation methods based on network topologies were surveyed from three prospects of node relevance, shortest path and other methods. The latest progresses in transmission mechanism were also reviewed in this paper. At last, some extensions of the node importance evaluations were analyzed and some future works are suggested.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination under information asymmetry considering customer's service free-riding behavior
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: We focus on a coordinating issue in the presence of service free-riding in a dual-channel supply chain consisting of a manufacturer and a traditional retailer. We incorporate information asymmetry into the model where the manufacturer has incomplete information about the retailer's cost of providing service, and present an analytical framework and obtain equilibrium decisions in a centralized scenario and a decentralized scenario, respectively. Then we propose a bidirectional revenue sharing mechanism (BRS mechanism) to coordinate the decentralized supply chain. We find that the supply chain with the BRS mechanism can achieve system optimization. Besides, the free-riding behavior can be reduced after the coordination is achieved. We also find that the coordination is not affected by the information asymmetry. However, the bargaining power and the information asymmetry jointly make impacts on the split of the system profit. The results can provide some managerial guidance for firms in practice.

articleTitle: Current status and framework of China's inland passenger ship safety system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Inland passenger shipping is one of the most convenient means of waterborne travel. However, recent serious accidents with passenger ships in China, have exposed a certain weakness in the country's inland passenger ship safety system. It is thus vital to overview the current conditions of China's inland passenger ship safety system, with regard to the different ship types, employment, management systems, legislative documents, specifications and standards, navigational regulations and emergency rescue procedures. In doing so, this paper analyses similarities and discrepancies with overseas inland river passenger ship safety systems. The paper then outlines the principles and proposes suggestions underlining the improved construction and implementation of the inland ship system. In particular, the last is done considering ship design, construction, operation, regulation, emergency rescue, practitioners, and relevant documents. The purpose of this work is to provide recommendations for policy making and scientific research on inland passenger transport with life cycle perspective.

articleTitle: An appraisal of lean construction project delivery application of lean construction
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: One major theoretical issue that has dominated the construction field for many years, concerns the general misconception that lean can only be successfully applied to manufacturing. Its introduction into design and construction industry has been slow due to a conflation of reasons including organisations disinclination to make the necessary capital investments. Recent research has shown that many aspects of the construction industry have improved with the development of lean construction. It has been suggested, however, that unpredictability in construction processes creates complications when implementing this philosophy to the industry. The aim of this paper was therefore to investigate the application of lean construction to construction project delivery. A framework for managing construction project delivery is proposed. To obtain the empirical research, a two-phase sequential mixed methods study was undertaken. The investigation concluded that heavy construction-engineering organisations are likely to successfully apply lean construction to construction project delivery, and achieve a new level of project performance if the appropriate considerations are given by the construction industry.

articleTitle: Declarative modeling cases of cyber physical systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: A Cyber-physical system (CPS) is an engineering system made of computational components, i.e. cyber elements, and physical elements, that are connected by a communication network. CPSs have emerged as the contemporarily leading technology in major industry sectors such as manufacture, aerospace, automotive, etc. Nowadays CPS is almost the synonym of control systems for large and complex engineering systems.
