In addition, CPSs have inevitably interweaved with new technologies like Internet of Things, cloud computing, ubiquitous computing, and big data processing. Taming the complexity has been the key challenge in CPS design. A novel declarative computing based platform was proposed in our previous paper to unify modeling and design of both cyber and physical components in CPSs. In this paper, the concepts and principles of the proposed declarative platform are depicted in details. In addition, modeling techniques of declarative networking and declarative control are showcased with concrete simulation examples.

articleTitle: The road to disruptive success
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This article explains the study conducted in order to test the hypothesis that the combination of disruptive innovation or, at least, revolutionary innovation, and visionary leadership are necessary conditions for the disruptive success of innovation-related startups. The author ranked, short-listed and then analyzed five cases in North America, one in Europe and three in East Asia. The analysis validates the tested hypothesis, suggests additional hypotheses and tips for further research.

articleTitle: Hazard identification in chemical supply chains: The development of a novel taxonomy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: An unforeseen event is a threat that can interrupt the operational process and has negative impacts on a supply chain system. To reduce the risks and improve the service level, hazard identification is one of the significant procedures in supply chain risk management (SCRM) to recognize the causes of undesired events across the supply chain network. However, the most SCRM studies in the chemical industry are spread across multiple disciplines and concentrated on various risks. This paper describes systematic hazard identification to comprehensively capture and verify the risk factors in the chemical supply chain (CSC). Through combining the distinct features of CSCs and the risks addressed in general supply chains, a risk taxonomic diagram is developed to decompose the unstructured risks into different categorizations from different supply, operational, demand, security, political, policy, macroeconomic and natural environment perspectives. It not only provides a portfolio of risks but also suggests the concerned hazardous events from industrial perspectives. It therefore provides a useful insight for risk mitigation in future.

articleTitle: The cold chain logistics enterprise's green level evaluation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Environmental deterioration problems have become increasingly prominent, which poses a serious threat to the survival and development of human society. cold chain logistics as the important method to ensure food quality, will generate huge energy consumption because it's strict temperature control, and the nonstandard logistics activity of cold chain logistics enterprise will cause the waste of resources and environmental pollution too, so the researches about green level of cold chain logistics has become increasingly important. This paper selecting the suitable green evaluation index and build a more reasonable and effective evaluation system, providing the basis for enterprises to find and solve the existing problems of cold chain logistics, so as to promote the sustainable development of cold chain logistics.

articleTitle: A cloud-oriented two-layer database model and itsalgebraic operations
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The existed cloud data models cannot well meet the management requirements of structured data including a great deal of relational data, therefore a two-layer cloud data model is proposed by referencing the relation data model, Hierarchical data model and key value data model. In the representation layer, the concepts of composite class and composite object are proposed to represent nested data structure and its instance. In the storage layer, two different triples are proposed to represent non-nested data structure and its instance. The conception of Rule is proposed to represent the relations of the data, and the conception of CAO (Component-Attribute-Object) is proposed to represent the data in non-nested data instance. The proposed model is fit for the management requirements of structured data in the cloud for using nested data to avoid join operation and using key-value model to store data. Algebraic operations including set operations and query operations are defined by referencing the algebraic operations of relation data model based on the proposed model. The conception of simple nested object is proposed to be the operation operand for set operation and selecting operation; therefore these operations have simple expression and ensure a correct result. The conception of attribute tree is proposed and is applied in the query operation to offer attributes selection. Theoretical analysis and example validation show that the proposed database model is effective and its algebraic operations are correct.

articleTitle: Collaboration modes and advantages in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This research aims to address supply chain collaboration with a perspective of broader three-dimensional relationship, not a linear two-dimensional relationship discussed broadly in previous research. Case study was adopted for this research, and data collection was mainly conducted via interview. The research results highlighted that supply chain collaborations are common practice across all levels of the pharmaceutical supply chain. The results also indicated that the different strengthen levels of barging power among collaborative partners will influence the achieved advantages at different supply chain levels, including strategic, operational and political levels.

articleTitle: An empirical study on the factors impacting Chinese customers purchasing intention on samsung smart phones
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Samsung smart phones as the global leading brand has been gaining amazing achievements in global market. However, Samsung has encountered serious frustration in Chinese market which behaved as the continual dropping of market share since 2014. This study used an empirical way to examine the factors impacting Chinese customers purchase intention on Samsung smart phones including country-of-origin image, corporate image, brand image and face-saving consuming based on the TRA theory. The findings indicated that the positive Korea country-of-origin image, positive corporate image and brand image devoted to a positive brand attitude from Chinese customers; the factor of face-saving consuming proved insignificant to lead to a positive brand attitude. Meanwhile, the correlation between brand image and purchase intention is not strong enough which indicated that the weak bran image of Samsung smart phones greatly impacted its sales in Chinese market.

articleTitle: Study on the inventory management of company E auto parts based on storage theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the increasing number of China's automobile production and ownership, the automobile industry faces new opportunities as well as challenges. Automobile industry, especially the environmental new energy vehicles, on one hand is facing a better policy environment and conditions; on the other hand, the competition has become more intense. OYOTA, Volkswagen and other international auto giants have settled in China, and at the same time, the domestic automobile have been rising. So many brands and companies increase the competition of the automobile market. This paper points out the problems of E company in inventory management, and puts forward the corresponding optimization strategies from improving the methods of demand forecasting and the method optimization of the inventory management.

articleTitle: A multi-theoretical perspective analysis of radical innovation research: An integrated framework
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Radical innovation enterprise's acquiring of innovational resources through network embeddedness helps to improve its innovation performance. Meanwhile, to obtain innovation legitimacy relying on network embeddedness is a critical element to ensure the success of radical innovation and get access to resource under the constraints of institutional environment. Following this principle, literature review is conducted in the first part of this paper, combining relevant theoretical studies of enterprise network, resource and institution. Focused on enterprise radical innovation, this paper proposes an integrated model analyzing the impact of network embeddedness, innovation legitimacy acquisition and innovation resource acquisition on radical innovation performance. This study aims to contribute to radical innovation theory by shedding light on the importance of the impact of innovation legitimacy on the success of radical innovation in institution theory perspective. It also has important implication for Chinese enterprises in the context of institutional transition and network embeddedness to develop innovation by building legitimacy and obtaining resources successfully.

articleTitle: Industry reconstruction and coordinated development of Yangtze River economic zone
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The basin area of Yangtze River Economic Zone is 1,981,083 square kilometers, 20% of China, and GDP accounted for nearly 45% in 2014. It has gathered a large number of key enterprises of equipment manufacturing, electronic information, petrochemical, chemical, iron and steel metallurgy, textile and clothing sector and strategic emerging industries. With rapid development, we have encountered a lot of problems, such as unbalanced regional development, unreasonable industrial layout, and ecological damage. This paper uses the grey correlation analysis to do an empirical analysis on cooperative relation between industrial development (measured by value-added of industry) and regional economic development (measured by GDP, total investment, urban population, students in regular higher education, length of highway, length of railway, length of navigable inland waterways). Meanwhile, we also do an empirical analysis on cooperative relation of eleven provinces within industrial development. The results showed that GDP, urban population, navigable inland waterway plays more active roles for industrial development, and the linkage of cities of the Yangtze River is weakness. Development for the future, it should fully take advantages of Yangtze River, accelerate the construction of modern industrial system, adjust and optimize the industrial layout, and promote regional industrial cooperation. Through many policy measures, Yangtze River economic zone can lay the foundation of China's economic development, and make communication at home and abroad.

articleTitle: Unilateral commitments: A prisoner's dilemma perspective
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: We explore factors that influence successful outcomes in exchange relationships in the presence of unilateral cooperative agreements through the lenses of game theory, Transaction Cost Economics, and Social Exchange Theory. We further investigate the impact of commitment length with regard to strategic cooperation. Based on the results of a modified prisoner's dilemma experiment with 85 participants, we find that unilateral commitments of shorter duration successfully drive partner cooperative behavior both during the periods of commitment and after the unilateral commitment to cooperate has ended. However, when long-term commitments are made we find that there is a significant decrease in partner cooperation. Our findings provide guidance surrounding the risky decision to initiate a cooperative arrangement within an exchange. Based on the results we observed, it may be best for an organization to show good faith in initiating a commitment to cooperate, but to be conservative in doing so. Short duration commitments appear to achieve balance and promote optimal outcomes.

articleTitle: Potential solutions to upstream buyer consolidation in the China-Europe container trades — An exploratory study
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Asia-Europe container trade is the most important trade in the world in terms of volumes transported (overtaking the Trans-Pacific trade in 2014). The typical structure of the supply chains associated with this trade is that containers are stuffed in China and the cargo is subsequently cross-docked at a major European logistics hub or closer to the customer, for further shipment to the final retailing point. This may be one of the reasons why short sea container shipping has only a limited market share of intra-European cargo flows, since once the cargo is unloaded from containers, it is more likely to be forwarded by land-based modes of transport. Paving the way for a greater proportion of cargo being cross-docked in China rather than Europe, may prove to be more cost-efficient and less environmentally damaging than the typical solution. This paper discusses the strengths and weaknesses of the typical solution and alternative solutions such as buyers' consolidation and concludes that new alternative solutions are worth investigating further. The potential for shifting from the typical solution to new alternatives is dependent on the identification of key decision makers in the design of these supply chains. As such, a careful analysis of this must be undertaken and the capability of Logistics service providers (LSPs) in China assessed.

articleTitle: A multi-objective, multi-product and multi-transportation mode sustainable closed-loop supply chain network design
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This research developed a mixed-integer mathematical model for a generic closed-loop supply chain network design (SCND), optimizing all three inherent dimensions of sustainability, namely, cost, environmental, and social impact, simultaneously. The proposed novel hybrid model is designed for a single period and takes into account some real-life characteristics of SC implementation such as multi-echelons, multi-products and multi-transportation modes. The weighted sum approach is used to solve that model on GAMS/CPLEX solver. In addition, the numerical testing is carried out in the case of an automotive SCND in UK Mercedes-Benz Car to test the validity of the proposed model. The result shows that the obtained solution is Pareto-optimal as it provides a `fair' compromise for conflicting trade-offs between cost, environmental, and social objectives.

articleTitle: The impact of current institutional arrangements on SOE's privatization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: An enduring debate between state and private ownership has long been topical in academic arenas. Every international scholar has his/her own view about SOE's privatization from different perspectives, such as the state system, property rights, contracting rights etc. The author generalizes the privatization in the first part, and then introduces the forms of privatization and functions; elaborates ownership theories. The paper mainly focuses on how the current institutional arrangements influence SOE's privatization. The current institutional arrangements involve property rights, contracting rights, political interference, etc. It also analyses how privatization influence on investment and growth, the relationship between privatization and financial development. We can draw a conclusion from existing literature that the stronger the economic and the governing institutions, the easier it is for privatized firms to thrive and contribute to growth.

articleTitle: Impact of corporate social responsibility on the speed of capital structure adjustment: A structural equation modeling approach
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This study has analyzed the effect of corporate social responsibility on the adjustment speed of capital structure towards the optimal or targeted one, by using data from the non-financial sector of Karachi Stock Exchange for years 2006 to 2014. The study has used structural equation modeling. The study has concluded that the relationship between CSR and speed of capital structure adjustment is significant through the mediating role of profitability. CSR has been found positively related to firm's profitability and profitability has been found negatively related to the speed of capital structure adjustment so the conclusion has been made for CSR and speed of capital structure adjustment relationship that higher the CSR is, lower will be the speed of capital structure adjustment.

articleTitle: An effective heuristic algorithm to solve tractor-and-trailer transportation scheduling problem with time windows
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the tractor-and-trailer transportation system, empty trailers always need to be dispatched insides owing to their same nature and uneven distribution of cargoes. Hence, they are also scheduling objects, as well as laden trailers. Compared with laden-trailer tasks whose origin and destination (OD) are clear, we can only know overall empty trailers' supply and demand, while specific OD are uncertain. Meanwhile, all tasks are required to be executed within a certain time span (time windows). Taking time windows into account, we develop an optimization model on the tractor-and-trailer transportation scheduling with uncertain empty-trailer tasks in road network, and design two-stage heuristic algorithm to solve it, where we raised four algorithms. In the first stage we aim to determine empty-trailer tasks and put forward two policies: (1) minimizing distance of transporting empty trailers; (2) minimizing the total surplus of laden-trailer tasks' OD. In the second stage we aim to schedule all tasks and another two policies were raised: minimum distance and minimum violation of time windows. Four numerical examples based on a practical operation are conducted. The first example shows that the four algorithms are superior to Simulated Annealing Algorithm to solve the problem. In the second example, when time windows width vary, Minimum Surplus Minimum Distance (MSMD) strategy performs best in accuracy. The third example demonstrates the stability of all four algorithms. In the last one, when the number of empty-trailer tasks varies, MSMD still shows obvious advantage in accuracy. Therefore, MSMD is proved to be an effective heuristic algorithm to solve this problem. Our study can be used in the actual truck-and-trailer transportation system with more reasonable decision support.

articleTitle: Applying interval knowledge to facilitate seaport container throughput volume forecasting
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Substantial studies integrating experts' knowledge with statistical forecasting models have been implemented to investigate a long-lasting and disputing issue, the extent to which expert knowledge can improve forecasting performance. However, many current studies are not capable of applying experts' interval knowledge in forecasting. Experts are expected to be more competent and confident, given that human brains do much better on fuzzy calculation like interval estimation than accurate computation like point estimation. To fill in this gap, this paper first proposes a new methodology incorporating interval knowledge which combines the interval knowledge generated by a Delphi-based expert system with the SARIMA model. For validation purposes, the proposed methodology is applied to forecast the container throughput volume of Qingdao port lying in the Bohai Rim, one of the most dynamic economic regions in China. The empirical results clearly show that interval knowledge, following the proposed methodology, significantly improves the forecasting performance. This finding implies that the proposed methodology has a potential to sharpen statistical models for container throughput forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on the dynamic capability affecting the growth performance of logistics service integrator
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Opening of China's logistics industry makes the growth of the logistics business faced with complicated contradictions. For logistics service integrator (LSI), enterprise wants to distinguish it from competitors and be better than the opponents in a dynamic market, the only way is to continue to innovate and maintain strategic flexibility, which keeps dynamic. Focusing on the theme of “how dynamic capabilities affect on the growth performance of logistics services integrator,” this thesis made some research: dynamic capability measure, the concept definition of LSI, study on construction of performance of dynamic capabilities of LSI growth theoretical models, and use dynamic capability to make an empirical analysis on the influence of growth of LSI. Finalize the structural model that dynamic capabilities impact on LSI growth performance. On the basis of empirical analysis, the authors deeply analyze mechanism of factors that affect growth merits of logistic service. The authors hope to guide the development of logistics enterprises and management practices which have certain significance.

articleTitle: Large, complex systems integrated support system research
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Integration of complex system security is the important research topics in equipment construction, involves many factors, the design is difficult. In this paper, on the basis of research the integration of security technology at home and abroad, has been clear about the related concept and connotation, summarized the development trend of equipment integrated support; Within the whole life cycle, from the overall technology, design, test and operational use four aspects analyzes the integration of key technologies; In a certain type of aircraft, for example, preliminary design and implementation of an integrated security system, in-depth study laid the foundation for the integrated security system.

articleTitle: Siting public charge stations for taxis in Beijing based on Monte Carlo simulation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the rapid increase of electric vehicle number, lacking of charge stations has been the most obvious problem. Although there exist some charge stations in Beijing now and more will be built, it will take a long time due to technological and social constraints. This paper studies the travel behavior of the customer and electric taxi. Based on the density functions of travel distance, departure time and state of charge, Monte Carlo simulation is applied to generate two randomly sequences, which including the departure events with travel distances and the state of charge value. Comparing the value of two sequences, and if the state of charge cannot ensure the travel distance at a certain time point, there's a charge demand. We get the charge demand function by this way, and the peak demand value at a certain time can also be found. Finally, we propose some park-lot-based siting locations and make a sensitivity analysis. The innovation of this paper is using travel behavior to simulate travel events in order to recognize charge demand, and the paper has proposed a model to site charge facilities that can satisfy the current demand of electric taxis.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between competency and job performance of university counselors: Moderating role of responsibility consciousness
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Undertaking the responsibility of student affairs management in universities, university counselors play an important role in assisting and guiding students to achieve their development tasks. It is of great significance to study the influence on the job Performance of competency and responsibility consciousness for strengthening the team management and promoting the job Performance of the university counselors. This study investigates the correlations between the competency, responsibility consciousness and the job performance of the university counselors via the method of questionnaire surveys; it discusses the moderating role on responsibility consciousness by using the Hierarchy Regression Analysis method. The result shows that the university counselor competency has a positive predicting impact on task performance, but no significant prediction on relationship performance. And the responsibility consciousness of the university counselors not only has positive effect on both task performance and relationship performance, but also has moderating effect between competency and both the two performances.

articleTitle: The impact of ICT costs on US trade in education
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of information and communicative technologies (ICT) costs and traditional trade determinants on US trade in education. An extensive panel data from 2000 to 2012 between the US and 49 partnering countries are used. Our findings show that for every 0.01% decrease in communication costs, US trade imports increases by 12.082% between 2000 and 2006; by 13.692% between 2007 and 2012; and on the aggregate at 13.114% between 2000 and 2012. In addition, GDP per capita is highly significant at 0.01% for all three time frames, holding positive and highly significant at 0.01% coefficients of 0.992, 0.7 and 0.86, respectively. Distance holds rather mixed results for the three time frames. Common language is a highly important factor when it comes to trade in education. For every 1% increase in common language, trade in education increases by 44.2% between 2000 and 2006. For every 1% increase in the use of a common language, trade in education increases by 45% from 2007 to 2012. For every 0.01% increase in common language, trade in education increases by 44.2% from 2000 to 2012. Our model provides can explain up to 52% of how communication costs impacts trade in education.

articleTitle: The impact that research and development investment has on financial performance in invironmental protection industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the 21st century, countries around the world have attached great importance to the development of science and technology. China put forward the “science and technology promoting environmental protection” strategy. Environmental protection is the focal point of economic growth, structural adjustment and people's livelihood improvement. The environmental protection industry in China started relatively late. There is a big gap with developed countries in the policies and regulations of environmental protection, the environmental protection industry enterprise scale and the policy guidance of environmental protection industry and so on. Environmental protection science and technology input region difference is very big, around the range of environmental protection industry development is unbalanced. In this paper, I will explore the differences and analyze the causes of differences by analyzing the current situation of the development of environmental protection industry at home and abroad. In addition, enterprise's profit ability and development ability both will be analyzed, by using the regression analysis method. Finally by comparing the empirical conclusion and using the experience of developed countries, the paper will put forward policy suggestions which can guide environmental protection enterprises to enhance research and development (R&D) investment in green technologies, promote the environmental protection industry in financial performance and promote the sustained and healthy development of environmental protection industry.

articleTitle: Management practices and firm performance: Mediating role of information technology, evidence from hotel industry, China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This study performs an empirical investigation that enlightens the mediating role of information technology (IT) among low transaction cost, tangible & intangible services, customer oriented approach and firm performance. The keystone of this study is how IT would influence firm performance discourses from a customer satisfaction perspective. This study used PLS-SEM technique to analyze survey data of 160 employees from hotel firms in Beijing, China. The direct and mediating relationship through IT among tangible & intangible services, customer oriented approach, and firm performance is significant. The direct relationship between low transaction cost and firm performance is also significant, however; the mediating role of IT among them is insignificant. Effective use of IT resources may create significant results.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis of the spatial links in China's outward foreign direct investment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Research on China's outward foreign direct investment has gained a lot of attention during the last two decades due to its rapid growth, though most studies ignore the spatial interdependence of outward foreign direct investment on the choice of Chinese outward foreign direct investment location. This study aims to examine the spatial links in China's outward foreign direct investment using the spatial lag model with China's outward foreign direct investment to 46 countries. The results show strong evidence of spatial links between Chinese outward foreign direct investments in different regions. Bilateral factors such as the host country's market demand, high investment openness attract Chinese outward foreign direct investment, while high-tech exports deters Chinese outward foreign direct investment.

articleTitle: Game analysis on the lower bound of optimal interval of knowledge heterogeneity in virtual practice community
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Knowledge Heterogeneity is the source of Knowledge Collaboration in Enterprise while the Virtual Practice Community constructed with Web 2.0 technology is a very important way to gain heterogeneous knowledge. Active Cross-border Innovation makes the virtual practice community to be heterogeneous knowledge preference nowadays. However, the appropriate degree of knowledge heterogeneity that can excite the community to be synergy equilibrium is difficult to seek. This paper studies on the signaling game analysis of knowledge heterogeneity in Virtual Practice Community based on two-period reputation model. We mainly analyze the lower bound of optimal interval of knowledge heterogeneity to reveal the management meaning of this optimal interval.

articleTitle: The effect of LSSC networks on the growth performance of logistic service integrator
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This research examines the influence of logistic service supply chain network (hereinafter referred to as the LSSC network) to the growth of logistic service integrator (LSI) from the perspective of social network. We divided the LSSC network into five sub-networks, they are social network, reputational network, marketing network, logistic collaboration network and logistic innovation network. We tested how the five sub-networks affecting the growth performance of LSI with the empirical methods. Eventually we concluded that the development of social network, logistic innovation network and marketing network has a significant impact on the growth of LSI; reputational network has an indirect impact on the firm growth by means of marketing network; and up to now, the development of logistic collaboration network is not very perfect, so it has little impact on the growth performance of LSI.

articleTitle: The changing nature of cargo container handling needs information sharing as a key performance indicator
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The growth in world trade is doubling every 5-7 years with a corresponding increase in cargo container movements most of which are handled by seaports. Moving more traffic through the limited area of a seaport can only be achieved by an increase in port performance. Ship owners, terminal operators and forwarding agents each have optimized their performance guided by values collected on key performance indicators. However, our results from a case study at Oslo port shows that operations suffer from insufficient information sharing resulting in an unused integration potential which not captured by the current performance indicators. We propose a new Information Sharing Indicator calculated as the sum of zero/one variables showing whether electronic information sharing between actors is shared (1) or not shared (0), plus with a value metric measuring the level of the information shared on a scale from 1 (lowest) to 3 (highest). We propose to extend the multi-dimensional port performance measurement framework commonly used by ports by extending it with the Information Sharing Indicator.

articleTitle: Electronic commerce in Romania: History, overview and projections
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Electronic commerce is a relatively new phenomenon in Romania, dating back to the early 2000's. During its short history, however, it has grown rapidly, particularly due to the advantages entailed for businesses, government and consumers alike. Specific disadvantages such as security risks, risks of fraud, piracy, corruption, low internet penetration rates and a culture prone towards traditional commerce have balanced the advantages and denied the possibility of a more rapid development in this field. While the market seems to have reached a standstill from a supply standpoint, it compensates with an influx of demand - thus quantitative measurements need to take qualitative transformation into account in order to provide a relevant rendition of how the national market is behaving. In these conditions we have aimed to research how Electronic commerce has transformed throughout the years, taking into account both actors and processes, only to observe that there is place for improvement in both government and business practice. In our conclusive remarks we argue that the size of the market will continue to increase in the years to come.

articleTitle: Self-organizing and edge of chaos analysis of the multi-agent traffic evolution model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to study the quantification of emergence in the complex transportation system, self-organizing traffic evolution model based on multi-agent is established by using the one-dimensional binary cellular automaton in which travellers' actual behavior is considered. “Decision coefficient” and “the evolution entropy of route choice” is transplanted form Langton parameter and evolution entropy of the cellular automata dynamics, which are used to quantify the group decision of transportation system, relationship between “decision coefficients” and “the evolution entropy of route choice” is discussed. The “edge of chaos” state of travellers' route choice is analyzed through genetic evolution computation aim for the traffic efficiency. The study found that (1) the relationship between “decision coefficients” and “the evolution entropy of route choice” accords with the conclusion of “edge of chaos” in cellular automata dynamics; (2) total travel time under “edge of chaos” state was superior to the traditional model; (3) the new model expressed the relationship between travellers' level of information interaction and traffic efficiency.

articleTitle: A route-like demand location problem based on squared-Euclidean distance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The location problem faced to route-like demand attracted more and more attention accompanying the rapid development of railway construction. In most location literatures, facility location problems meeting spot-demand are fully involved, while its counterpart is rarely mentioned. Even if referring to route-like demand, most literatures disperse it into spot-demand. This paper considers a facility location problem with route-like demand in railway construction. A curvilinear model based on squared-Euclidean distance is presented and a precise optimal solution is obtained.

articleTitle: Analysis of public crisis management and development strategies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The society today has entered a period during which crises happen frequently, their destruction escalates and their international inter action develops. Thus GCM (government-crisis-management) becomes an important and compelling task for all countries and all levels of government. For China, which is in its transitional period, the management of social crises will have a direct bearing on the image of the government, influence the political and economic stability and development of the country, and therefore will determine the existence of the State power. This paper analyzes the types and causes of public crises and points out the administrative problems in coping with public crisis, hoping to provide constructive advice of the government to timely and effectively deal with different types of public crises and go smoothly through the transformation period.

articleTitle: A purchasing management strategy model about grading and classifying railway materials based on material grouping
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The article analyses current situation and some critical problems in railway materials purchasing. In order to improve the management, a purchasing management Strategy model about grading and classifying railway materials is proposed. The model is based on material grouping method and provides basis for decisions about key problems such as how to divide the purchasing management authority, how to choose the mode of purchasing. To verify the effectiveness of the model, the calculation using the data of purchasing is carried out. The calculation results show that the model can provide targeted strategies for grouped materials. The research results provide the ideas of the fine purchasing management for China Railway Corporation.

articleTitle: The dynamic relationship between the real estate stocks and price in China new normal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The central economic conference takes decreasing the real estate stocks as one of the five tasks this year. It's of great realistic and theoretical significance to find the mutual influence between the price of commercial house and the area for sale. This study uses PVAR model to explore the impact of real estate stocks on the real estate investment and house price in 31 provinces of China in 1998 to 2014. The result shows the real estate stocks are influenced by its own factors in a short time and by the house price in a long time. The house price is the dominant factors on its own change whether in a short or long time. The impact of the real estate stocks on housing price changes over time, but it's not the dominant factors.

articleTitle: The opportunities and solutions to solve critical issues of Chinese logistics in internet plus era
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Logistics is the key element to economy, and the rapid development of Chinese economy needs a better logistic development environment. However, Chinese logistic is still in a low-level, inefficient and ineffective. The Chinese market and information technology development provides great chances to logistic improvement. The article reviewed Chinese logistics real condition, trends, critical issues and policy trends in Internet plus era. Finally, the article gave some suggestions for Chinese authorities about how to promote logistics reasonably and effectively in Internet plus era.

articleTitle: Overlapping trend detection and application in prediction
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Traditional time series studies pay more attention to the representation effect of original sequence rather than to the trend contained in it. And overlapping trends are ignored because of the usual way for extracting trend from time series is decomposition or segmentation. A sufficient long sequence is also required when doing prediction with trend analysis, or only disappointing results would be gotten. This paper introduces sliding window to improve the inertia test based trend detection algorithm. The data of experiments show that the improved algorithm gets the target of overlapping trend detection and short sequence prediction.

articleTitle: Application of BP neural network to animal transports monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: According to the demands of monitoring method for animal transports, this paper proposes the use of a BP neural network based algorithm to monitor the animal transports, using the wireless sensor network to monitor the environment during transport to assure the animal welfare. The algorithm requires data collection on the transportation cage with respect to temperature, humidity, air pressure, vibration and animal pulses, and is composed of two parts: early-warning and evaluation. The two parts comprise of Statistical Process Control model for early-warning and Fuzzy Logic model for evaluating, respectively. Performance tests reveal the technical feasibility of the monitoring algorithm for animal transports.

articleTitle: Study on labor relations from the perspective of “The belt and road initiative”
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Under the circumstance of new normal of Chinese economy, the strategy of “The Belt and Road Initiative” brings new opportunities for China's economic transformation and upgrading, the promotion of economic development in the surrounding countries and regions, as well as Chinese enterprises to “go out”. However, a large number of overseas investment plans continued to collapse because they were failed to deal with labor relations in the past. Therefore, the key to Chinese enterprises to go abroad and seek long-term development by means of “The Belt and Road Initiative” lies in the ability to deal with labor relations, and creating a harmonious business environment to ensure the steady development of enterprises so as to indirectly complete the national strategic layout. This paper analyzes key factors that affect labor relations on the basis of “The Belt and Road Initiative” countries. At the same time, it gives three required keys to deal with labor relations so as to avoid conflicts.

articleTitle: Quality control for express items based on Markov decision process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the development and maturity of the express industry, the compression of the delivery time is gradually approaching the limit. The consumers pay more attention to the quality of the express items. It has become an important issue for the express enterprises. However, due to the privacy policy of the express, express enterprises can only identify the state of internal items through the external packaging generally, and take statistical control after the event. It is difficult to guarantee the quality of the items timely and effectively. This paper draws an analogy between the production process quality inspection in system engineering and quality control of express within the delivery process, considering the states of the express items change dynamically. Aiming at the minimum total cost, a Markov decision process model is established to find out the optimal setting for the quality inspection stations within the delivery process. Thus, enterprises can reduce the damage of expresses, improve customer service level, and enhance the competitiveness.

articleTitle: Vehicle routing problem with simultaneous delivery and pick-up under different weights
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to solve the enterprise's actual problem and meet the demand under different priority level of new product distribution and old product recycling in business enterprise, This paper improves the traditional vehicle routing problem with simultaneous delivery and pick-up. Considering the importance of the new product distribution and old product recycling in enterprise operation, we put forward the pickup and delivery vehicle routing optimization problem under different weights and establish a mathematical model. With the introduction of power grid enterprise actual calculation example and by using lingo, a software tool to solve mathematical model, for calculating, we analyze and verify the effectiveness of the model and its actual effect.

articleTitle: Study of risk allocation in ppp projects based on altruistic theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In PPP (Public-Private Partnership) projects, a reasonable risk-sharing system determines whether project financing will be successful. As “economic men” with limited rationality, both the government and the investors have altruistic preferences during cooperation, and their behaviors and incentive strategies can be explained and designed by the principal-agent theory. In order to study how project participants' altruistic preferences affect risk distribution, this paper developed a risk allocation model based on the principal-agent theory. The study shows that the risk sharing ratio is related to the players' altruistic preferences, the expected revenue, costs and efforts facing the investors. We find that government's altruism actually undermines investors' enthusiasm in cooperation and the risk sharing propensity, although it increases the utilities of both parties.

articleTitle: The preliminary discussion of financial information management solutions for universities
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the leap-forward development of information technology, as well as the development strategy requirement of the financial information management, financial information construction for universities becomes the essential means to improve financial management and the quality of financial services. The financial information construction for universities should not only strengthen the management of financial information, financial information analysis, financial internal control and financial information security, as well as enhance the decision analysis of financial information. This paper mainly discusses how to build financial information management solutions, how to integrate the financial information platform through financial system, and provide data support for other management system. Through the establishment of financial information management solutions, universities can effectively improve the efficiency of financial business, enhance the level of financial management, strengthen financial control and reduce financial risks, so as to build security, standardized, scientific and sustainable university financial information management.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy of “Go-global” for hydropower engineering construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the “Go-global” strategies such as “OBOR” presented by Chinese government, The Chinese hydropower engineering construction enterprises' overseas business develop at a high speed. This article not only analyzed the current situations of these enterprises but also put forward the strategy of “Go-global” for hydropower engineering construction enterprises in the new period to improve their competitiveness.

articleTitle: Content analysis of we media marketing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the rise of a series of We Media platforms like forum, Microblog, and We chat, humans' thinking ways, channels of receiving information as well as living habits have changed dramatically due to the influence of virtual society created by We Media. Therefore, traditional marketing model needs a radical change. Based on the basic marketing theory, this paper adopts content analysis for the first time to investigate the marketing strategy. There are three main research stages: data collection, data processing and data analysis. A successful case will be selected for an empirical study through the actual data analysis and statistics. Finally, We Media marketing strategy will be summarized according to the results of data analysis.

articleTitle: Logistics industry convergence and risk assessment based on business process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Convergence development between logistics industry and related industries has been a general trend, but there are many risks in the Convergence process. Logistics real estate is typical form integrated by logistics industry and estate industry; there still exist many potential risks in its development process. The paper begins with analyzing the risk factors and built risk index system based on logistics real estate development process. Then the paper establishes a risk assessment model by using entropy method. At last, the paper carries on quantitative assessment empirical research on the basis of case collected in West China. The result shows that the risk index system based on process could cover the whole stage of logistics real estate development. As a simple and effective method of risk assessment, entropy method could exclude human factors interference of index weight and make evaluation results more objectively.

articleTitle: The optimal parameter combination for vehicle detection from worldview-2 imagery
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Vehicle detection and traffic flow parameters extraction from high resolution imagery have been popular research topics in recent years. Object-based image analysis, with the aid of commercial eCognition<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">®</sup> software, has become a widely implemented method for vehicle detection and identification. In the process, the determination of optimal segmentation parameters is of crucial importance for the accuracy of vehicle detection and classification. In this study, we obtained the optimal parameter combination for vehicle detection by a “trial-and-error” strategy using road subsets as sample clipped from WorldView-2 imagery. A better vehicle detect result would be obtained easily in 0.5m resolution images when the scale value was 30, the shape value was set to 0.4, and the compactness value was kept constant as 0.5. At the same time, an obvious tendency was also revealed that the segmentation accuracy of vehicles tended to descend gradually holding the scale value constant with the increasing of shape value, and the accuracy descended sharply when the shape value was larger than 0.5; it was also descending generally holding the shape value constant with the increasing of scale value. The experiment results can be applied directly to the vehicle detection from the same resolution images with similar vehicle size and would also be a useful reference for quick setting of original parameters in other conditions.

articleTitle: The identification and analysis of the logistics system in management of the division of the assay office
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The article presents the problem of identification and analysis of processes and resources of the logistics system in management of the Division of the Assay Office in Czestochowa (Poland) in the process of determination of gold content in jewelry alloys. In the fundamental process, developed in the logistics system of the administrative body, i.e. in the process of determination of gold content in jewelry alloys, there have been identified and analyzed two basic sub-processes, depending on the purity of the product, and indicated the basic tasks and relations of the investigated system.

articleTitle: Demand level judgment under buyback contract: Effects of newsvendor behavior
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Judging demand change when demand shifts from one level to another usually relies on the decision makers' intuition, which involves behavior factors and would lead to decision biases in inventory decision making. To cope with the biases of demand level judgment in supply chains under buyback contracts, this paper studies how do two behavior factors, i.e., mental accounting and system neglect, influence the process that the supply chain members judge the demand changes. To reveal the judgment differences among supply chain members, we consider a two-stage supply chain that comprises a buyer and a seller. The buyer is assumed to be irrational, while the seller is assumed to be rational. The possibility of demand change and the magnitude are considered when the buyer and the seller judge the demand change. By comparing the optimal judgments of the buyer, the seller and the whole chain, we find that the buyback mechanism leads the supply chain members digress from the optimal cutoff values, which maximize the expected profits of the whole channel. Surprisingly, we find that mental accounting is a positive factor for eliminating the judgment digression while system neglect is a negative one. We discuss the implication for aligning the judgments of different members of the supply chains with buyback contract.

articleTitle: Research on database audit scheme design of life insurance industry based on OLAP technology
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The database audit is one of important mean to protect the security of database. In the life insurance industry, because of it master a large amount of important customer-related information, it is necessary to database audit. With the increasing of audit records and the requirement of database audit, simple means based audit log data unable to take full advantage of its intrinsic value. Thus, this paper presents a database audit scheme of life insurance industry based on OLAP (Online Analytical Processing) technology. We establish the data warehouse of database audit by designing conceptual model, logical model and ETL (Extraction-Transformation-Loading). On this basis, we use OLAP technology to achieve multi-level audit analysis, which can improve the efficiency and flexibility of database audit work.

articleTitle: Benefit distribution mechanism of swap trailer transport alliance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Establishing a fair and reasonable benefit distribution mechanism is of great significance to promote the development of the swap trailer transport alliance. According to the specific characteristics of swap trailer transport, the two-stage benefit distribution plan based on the classical Shapley value is established. Numerical analysis shows that benefit distribution model is more accordance with the income expectancy of the enterprises after second correction. The benefit distribution plan is more reasonable, and alliance members can obtain more satisfactory income.

articleTitle: Production and pricing policy of ATO manufacturer with heterogeneous customer segment and demand
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Under the assumption that customers divided into different independent segments have heterogeneous preference on products of a product family and sensitivities to their prices, this paper proposes an ATO (Assemble-to-Order) manufacturer production and pricing model to study how the ATO manufacturer meets the heterogeneous demands of consumers from different segments by product selection and pricing. It is found that a product family ATO manufacturer would better always keep more than one type of product are available in the market to better meet customers' heterogeneous demands and provide only one flagship product to every customer segment.

articleTitle: The impact of organizational learning and supply chain collaboration on service innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate the relations among organizational learning, supply chain collaboration and service innovation performance. We use Structure Equation Model and Amos 20.0 to test the influence among constructs. Through an empirical survey of 243 samples in South China, the results show that: (1) Different dimensions of organizational learning have different effects on different dimensions of supply chain collaboration. (2) Different dimensions of organizational learning have different effects on service innovation performance. (3) Supply chain collaboration has a mediating effect on the relationship between knowledge absorption, knowledge integration and service innovation performance, but does not act as a mediator between learning intent and service innovation performance. The segmentation study in this paper gives some theoretical value and instructive on research of supply chain collaboration, organization learning and service innovation performance, and enriches the empirical research of these areas in some extent.

articleTitle: Capacity assessment error elimination and evaluation methods
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By analyzing two groups of capacity assessment data, the paper obtained such data characteristics as data discreteness and frequency domain, and established an error analysis model and an error evaluation model for the above data on the basis of their characteristics. When reducing random errors, the paper compared merits and demerits of mean filters and median filters, and improved mean filters according to data discreteness. By referring to the evaluation results of the error evaluation model, it chose median filters as the method in the paper to eliminate high-frequency random errors. In this way, not only random errors are reduced, but the rules for systematic errors are maintained. Then, neural networks were used to fit the systematic error function, aiming to reduce systematic errors and to achieve data consistency as well. Finally, the fitted systematic error function was used for actual fitting of the second measurement data that had passed the median filters, thus random errors and systematic errors were reduced.

articleTitle: Study on the influential mechanism of monetary policy fluctuation and internal control on firm financial constraints
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Using the data of A-share enterprises in the years between 2004 and 2012, this study investigates the relationship among the fluctuation of monetary policies, internal control, and financial constraints. The results show that although financial constraints are common among the firms, financial constraints tend to be strengthened by monetary contractions, and internal control could mitigate the positive effect of monetary contractions of financial constraints. After distinguishing between firms in different external environments and internal characteristics, we find that under monetary contractions, internal control could have greater mitigating effect on financial constraints in the enterprises which are located in areas with low degree of marketization and in private enterprises than in the enterprises which are located in areas with high degree of marketization and in state-owned enterprises. This study confers a new perspective on the determinants of financial constraints, provides evidence for the credit transmit channel of monetary policy, and gives empirical support to the internal control building of companies in our country.

articleTitle: High-dimensional data clustering for customers with duplicate attribute values
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Customer analysis problem is often involved in high-dimensional data analysis. In addition, the duplicates often disrupt the cluster analysis. This paper focuses on the customer analysis of an educational organization by clustering. Eliminating duplicates is implemented to improve the clustering result.

articleTitle: Analysis of the optimization railway route from Romania to Poland in “one belt and one road”
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This article is to study European railway transportation plan on the background of railway transportation in New Silk Road Economic Belt. It is focused on railway transport routes which have not been involved in New Silk Road Economic Belt, rather than the railway transportation routes that have been founded. Finally, we selected the railway transport route between Romania to Poland as research object. We are aimed to find out the optimal path of railway transportation from Romania to Poland.

articleTitle: Research on the coordination strategy in the supply chain with substituting procurement financing based on option contract
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The substituting procurement financing mode solves the difficult financing problems caused by the small and medium-sized enterprises' funding constraints, but it also has the problems of efficiency loss. Based on the supply chain constituted by a third party logistics (3PL) company and one retailer in this paper, we analyze and prove the efficiency of introducing the option contract into the substituting procurement financing mode, and give the reasonable option pricing combination through the Newsboy model. It shows that there is a reasonable option pricing combination in the substituting procurement financing mode that lets supply chain achieve effective coordination, namely that the total ordering under the option contract reaches the centralized decision-making level without option contract, and retailer's and logistics company's profits both achieve an great improvement. Finally, we use a numerical example to verify the correctness of the results.

articleTitle: “Internet +” railway construction projects' creative purchasing model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This article combining Internet development under innovation 2.0 with the new form of material management, take West Inner Mongolia Central Railway Corporation for example. Through discussion, it propose a new mode of railway materials management and solve the problem which are widespread of the current construction enterprise material management. It will solve deep-seated problems existing in the current construction enterprise material management from the source.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis on the bullwhip effect based on “Farming-Supermarket Docking”
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Customers' demand is changing constantly. The bullwhip effect takes shape when this situation of asymmetric information is enlarged or amplified partly due to farmers' failure to acquire the accurate information. “Farming-Supermarket Docking” is introduced to make farmers and big sellers like supermarkets sign the contract, allowing farmers to supply farm products directly to the cooperation institution, who will supply the supermarkets after the resource integration. In contrast to the conventional way, this docking removes the progress of passing on between members, also preventing the products from going bad during repeating transportation. Extends is utilized as modeling after analyzing the demands and current situation upon supply chain of farm products, and secondly used as modeling for the supply chain under the situation of “Farm-Supermarket Docking”. Finally, we will optimize “Farm-Supermarket Docking” by added information sharing mechanism. After the contrast of the bullwhip effect, we can test and verify the feasibility and effectiveness for “Farm-Supermarket Docking” to reduce the damage that bullwhip effect causes.

articleTitle: The internet company realize independent innovation from imitation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Here comes the Internet economy rapid development time. And the Internet companies play an increasingly important role in Chinese economic construction and social development. Along with the social networking make great advances to the universal social. As one of the leading enterprises, the Tencent seized the moment and reached many achievements by WeChat. In Internet industry, there is a widely accepted point that emphasizes the technology and innovative achievements is free to the others, so it is difficult to protect intellectual property. As a result, most of the time it is feasible to imitate, but the key to decide the success of a product is to meet the needs of users and win the users' approval. In this paper, I will discuss several instant messaging software, including WeChat, MiTalk in China and Kik in Canada. By combining theory with practice, I tend to relate Tencent's imitation and innovation to its own conditions, and the influence of the Internet industry characteristic. This paper analyzes how the Tencent realize its own innovation from the previous imitation.

articleTitle: Research on inventory issues based on carbon trading when the inventory capacity is limited
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The environmental pollution and climate change are threatening people's daily life. Our country and government have taken more and more measures to control the carbon emissions, and there will be a carbon emissions trading market where enterprises can buy or sell their right to discharge carbon in our country soon. So the carbon emission costs have been a problem that enterprises have to take into consideration and the purchase and inventory tactics based on which have been problems that enterprises consider too. This paper research the inventory problems when the inventory capacity is limited, add carbon emission factors to traditional purchase strategy, comprehensively take carbon quota and carbon trading into account, and improve the inventory model that the inventory capacity is limited under the low carbon environment. This paper testify that carbon trading mechanism can truly decrease the carbon emission through the calculation and derivation, derive the change regular of the optimal order quantity when the carbon price and coefficient of carbon emissions, and derive the level of carbon emissions that an enterprise do not need to sell or buy the right to discharge carbon.

articleTitle: Research on product feature extraction for Chinese reviews
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Opinion mining technique aims at automatically obtaining valuable information by retrieving and processing product reviews on the web, product feature extraction is the key step for opinion mining. Currently, the product feature extraction has been studied a lot in the field of English. However, the research of Chinese feature extraction is insufficient. There exist many issues such as small size of datasets, low precision rate, etc. In this paper, we put forward a feature extraction algorithm for Chinese reviews based on Apriori algorithm on the basis of Chinese language characteristics. Experiments with a large number of real network reviews data are carried out and good results are obtained. The experiment results show that this algorithm is effective and has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: Network layout of multimodal logistics park for the central region in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Development of multimodal transport and Logistics Park are the two important works in the development of the logistics industry, including the effective combination of multimodal transport and Logistics Park, that is, the construction of multimodal Logistics Park. In this case, this paper takes the central region in China as the study, chooses several cities as the selected cities to construct the network layout of the park in this area, and puts forward to factors need to be considered in the course. Finally, using Matlab and fuzzy cluster analysis, the paper classifies the selected cities and obtains the dynamic clustering map of these cities, which is the reference for the network layout of multimodal transport Logistics Park in the central region.

articleTitle: Research on the comprehensive material flow index of the state based on sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, the destruction of the ecological environment caused by modern logistics is becoming more and more serious, many countries and regions have put forward different measures of energy saving and emission reduction. The sustainable development of the logistics industry has become the inevitable requirement of the economic development of all countries. Logistics related indexes in analyzing the reasons of economic changes and predicting the future development trend have good effect. These indexes provide scientific bases for the national economic policies. Based on the material flow theory and comprehensive logistics theory, this article puts forward the ESN-DSR structural model. And then it establishes the system and algorithm of sustainable comprehensive material flow index. This index aims to provide decision references of sustainable development of material flow for governments.

articleTitle: Simulation verification for go-Bayes analysis method based on RCM theory
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper based on the theory of reliability centered maintenance (RCM) techniques aimed to verify the analysis results obtained by GO-Bayes method. This paper addresses the problem of establishing Monte Carlo simulation model to simulate the braking system. Metro vehicle braking system has been selected as it is one of the most complex and high-technology systems among all devices of train vehicles with high requirement on safety. As a whole, GO-Bayes analytical method has the accurate results which are consistent with Monte Carlo simulation, with the increase of simulation, its results will be closer to analytical calculated value.

articleTitle: Tianjin port throughput prediction based on PCA and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In view of the actual situation in the port of Tianjin, to overcome the traditional BP neural network method in the prediction model, such as low efficiency and poor accuracy of faults, the paper puts forward a kind of prediction model based on principal component analysis (PCA) and BP neural network. In this approach, use PCA to reduce the dimension of the original data, so as to achieve the purpose of simplifying the network structure. The calculation results of SPSS and MATLAB software show that PCA-BP neural network prediction model compared to traditional BP neural network model can improve the prediction efficiency and improve accuracy. Therefore, this method is more suitable for predicting the throughput of the port of Tianjin, and it has a strong practical significance.

articleTitle: Study on efficiency of supply chain based on single revenue sharing contract and double contracts combination
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Supply chain contract plays an important role in the coordination of members of supply chain. The existing application of supply chain contracts is mainly based on a single contract, which exist some limitations. From the point of combination of supply chain contracts, we establish two models based on system dynamics, one is revenue sharing contract model and the other is the combination model consisting of quantity discount contract and revenue sharing contract. Then, we use Vensim to simulate. The results show that the combination model is more conducive to the overall efficiency of the supply chain. This paper provides a new way for the study on supply chain coordination.

articleTitle: Comparison of the system of construction quality control on cross-strait
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Construction engineering products have the characteristic of one-time, so high quality is the eternal pursuit of various countries and various areas all over the world. In recent years, frequent accidents are triggered by inferior engineering quality, and the consequences of loss cannot be estimated. So, the construction engineering quality caused the extensive concern of the government, strengthening the supervision and management becomes the main current work. On June 21, 2013, with the signing of Cross-Strait Service Trade Agreement, it has a regulation: Taiwanese stakes in companies can bidding project in the mainland, Taiwan open construction and renovation industry. The rule provides an opportunity for the exchange of cross-strait construction development. Because both sides of the social system is different, the management system of construction project is different, too. In order to solve the system obstacles for communication development. This paper uses the literature research, comparison research methods, analyses both sides of the construction project quality supervision system, to form the main innovative results of the article. After comparison and analysis, putting forward improvement opinions.

articleTitle: Modeling and algorithm of logistics channel selection based on the network utility of nodes and edges
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As the logistics and supply chain network develops, it becomes increasingly important to make better decision of the logistics channel. In this paper we expand the concept of centralities of node degree and edge betweenness. Afterwards we establish the logistics channel selection model taking not only the travel time and infrastructure costs but the network utility of the channel into consideration. Subsequently, a combination algorithm of Dijkstra algorithm, Floyd algorithm and i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> shortest path algorithm is developed to solve the problem of our model. At last, a numerical experiment is conducted to verify the validity of the model and the algorithm. The research offers a new approach to the strategic logistics decision-making.

articleTitle: Bi-level programming model to ticket price of Lan-xin high-speed railway based on competitive perspective
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: By analyzed the transport mode division of Lan-xin Corridor, and according to the way each passenger transport products that can provided by different modes, the transport modes competition was classified as passenger transport product competition. On this basis, built the bi-level programming model of passenger fares in Lanzhou to Xinjiang high-speed railway based on products competition: the upper level aims to maximize the railway revenue and lower level aims to minimize the passengers cost under the various conditions of passenger transport products and improved particle swarm algorithm be used to solve the model. The results show that the real fare of the first class and the second class is lower than the optimal results, and the fare can be adjusted timely according to the conditions of passenger flow cultivation in the subsequent operation.

articleTitle: Study on decisions of centralized and decentralized inventory control of fresh food dual-channel
