publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: For inventory control strategy, the more common side strategy is centralized inventory control strategy and decentralized inventory control strategy. In this paper, multiple retailers on the supply chain are chose as research objects to study the inventory control strategy under random demand of these retailers in a multi-period inventory system. Considering the shortage costs and inventory holding costs, multi-period stochastic inventory models are built to compare the difference between traditional decentralized inventory control strategy and centralized inventory control strategy based on risk sharing. The findings show the advantages of centralized inventory control. Besides, this paper also analysis the influence of demand relevance on the performance of centralized inventory control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on financing method of public charging facilities based on cooperative game
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Concerning the construction of charging piles, opportunities coexist with challenges. It refers to a series of issues, such as who should bear the cost, and how to achieve maximum cost saving. At present, there are three parties, namely the local government, State Grid Corporation of China, and clean-energy vehicle manufacturers, willing to invest in the construction, thus leads to the formation of the three party cooperation game situation. Questions remain to study as to which way is the best to achieve cooperation and win-win situation among the following: fulfill the construction by a single party, a double party alliance, or a triangular party alliance. Meanwhile, if it is a triangular party alliance, questions such as how to share the cost in a fair and reasonable way will be involved. This article will focus on the specific charging facilities construction needs of a city in China, conduct in-depth analysis, and calculate the cost sharing of charging pile construction by Shapley value method. We not only hope to provide support, which will help to choose the best cost sharing plan for local government, State Grid Corporation of China, and clean-energy vehicle manufacturers, but also to provide theoretical basis for fair and reasonable cost sharing in charging pile construction.

articleTitle: Government subsidies, capital structure and enterprise growth: An empirical study based on the new energy industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The State Council proposed to develop the strategic emerging industries and give them some support in terms of policy in 2010. Under the policy context, this paper selected the new energy industry as the research object. Based on the panel data of the new energy industry from 2010 to 2014, we found that government subsidies had a weak positive correlation with the capital structure but a significantly positive correlation with the growth of enterprises of the new energy industry. That is to say that the government subsidies can ease corporate financing constraints to some extent and promote the development of enterprises of new energy industry. But we also found that the new energy industry was still faced with the problem of an unreasonable debt structure. So the government needs to further clear the financing channels for the enterprises. We also found an insufficient solvency of the new energy enterprises, through the analysis of corporate cash flow from operating activities. This indicates that enterprises with high growth need to pay attention to financial risks and that government subsidies for new energy industry should be sustainable.

articleTitle: A study on international cooperation of Chinese ports under the context of the 21st century maritime silk road
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: As part of the “going out” strategy, Chinese ports have begun to carry out cooperation with pivot ports in regions along the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, resulting in the construction of a port network to serve the “One Belt, One Road” initiative. It is not only conducive to the development of Chinese ports, but also enables the shipping industry to play its due role in promoting the coordinated development of regional economy. To select a pivot port, firstly, identify the port functions in different regions; secondly, select the target ports; finally, propose specific ports cooperation model based on the corresponding port situation. Port Klang in Malaysia, Port of Djibouti in the Republic of Djibouti, Port of Arzew in Algeria, and Port of Lagos in Nigeria meet the basic requirements for providing services to the pivot ports along the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road, and cooperation models as joint ventures and BOT will be adopted.

articleTitle: Financial supporting strategies for regional economic growth: A case study of shaanxi province in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Regional financial markets are acknowledged as the determinant influencing and restraining regional economic development with deepening economic financialization. However, there is no clear and well-acknowledged understanding about to what degree regional financial development is correlated with regional economic growth, whether the correlation varies from one region to another, and how regional finance facilitates regional economic growth. This paper discusses the financial supporting strategies for regional economic growth by taking Shaanxi province as an example and discloses the correlation of regional economic growth with regional financial development. With regard to a region, the improvement of regional financial structure and efficiency is an effective way to promote regional economic growth. The regional financial market facilitates the growth of regional economy by increasing capital fluidity, accumulating capitals for industrial development, strengthening corporate governance, offering risk management, and providing information about economic development.

articleTitle: The determinant analysis of capital structure for listed companies in hebei province
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The capital structure remarkably determines the debt paying and refinancing capacity of an enterprise and then influences the future earning level. In this paper, firstly we analyze the conditions and characteristics of the capital structure of 24 listed companies in Hebei Province through the related data from 2006 to 2015. Then, we examine the mainly micro-factors to capital structure by the empirical analysis. The results show that the profitability and the company scale are the major factors that influence the capital structure. Firm size and debt ratio are positively related, meanwhile, profitability is negatively related to debt ratio. In addition, asset structure, growth of company and the level of specialization are all not significantly related to the capital structure.

articleTitle: Analysis of the development of housing industrialization based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The development of housing industrialization in China has just started and it is still in the initial stage. The development of the housing industrialization has encountered great resistance and failed to form a complete industrial chain because of the lack of relevant standards of domestic industrialization and system. The housing industrialization can improve the quality and performance of the residential effectively and greatly shorten the construction period. The cost will be greatly reduced because of the scale effect. The research object is the housing industrialization. The housing market, city economy, various elements of city population and the development of the housing industrialization will be integrated as a whole system. This study establishes the development strategy of housing industrialization system dynamics model. This paper has contributed in the establishment of SD model in housing industrialization and this simulation model provides support for the development strategy of housing industry, which is benefit for the development of housing industrialization and provides help for the development of housing industrialization even the whole construction industry.

articleTitle: Research on the conflict analysis of dual-channel supply chain based on graph model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, one typical conflict problem in dual-supply chain is researched. The method of graph model is applied to solve the conflict problem, firstly, take the uncertainty into consideration when selecting the strategy of decision makers in dual-supply chain, secondly, make sure the auxiliary decision based on the matrix form. Then the graph model is established and equilibrium point is obtained by the decision support system(MRCR), finally, a resolution of the conflict is available after analysis.

articleTitle: The select of cross border electronic commerce information system modes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Management information system is the nervous system of the enterprise, and it's essential to every enterprise. Combined with the business environment of cross border e-commerce, and according to the different characteristics of cross border e-commerce which has different operation modes, this paper proposes reasonable and efficient management information system, and points out the unfavorable factors of the construction of the current cross border electronic commerce information system.

articleTitle: Income tax's rate and M&A transactions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Based on the listed company Enterprise merger and acquisition (M&A) cases of China in 1994~2014, this paper examines the Income tax's influence on M&A transactions by empirical method. Our empirical tests have two perspectives, macro and micro. We find that in macro aspect, income tax rates have negative impact on M&A scale. In micro aspect, the rate of the acquired party has positive impact to the premium of the transaction and in taxable samples is significantly positive. The desire to improve the transaction pricing isn't strong for untaxable M&A.

articleTitle: A two-phase greedy strategy in one to many PDVRP
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The extension class of the traditional vehicle routing problem, where there are several tasks in a goods transportation and goods are transported from one pickup point to many delivery points in each task, is studied in order to schedule vehicle routes with the lowest cost. A two-phase greedy strategy was put forward based on one to many pickup and delivery vehicle routing problem. The inner routing of a task was established in the first phase, and the routing between tasks was scheduled in the second phase. The mathematical model was set up under the single depot and sole vehicle model, and with the mileage limit and time window constraints. The experiment results show that two-phase greedy strategy is feasible and effective and also it can get better optimal results in mileage and cost saving than the improved clarke-wright algorithm.

Author Keywords: one to many pickup and delivery problem

articleTitle: How to build a standard system of community care service for elderly? A research based on the condition of China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Facing the challenges of aging, Chinese government is actively exploring the development mode of elderly service system. The main problem of Chinese elderly service system is lacking of standards, the international elderly service standards and Chinese elderly service standards both have not release a standard of community care service system for the aged yet, that resulting in a lack of scientific and completed service providing standard; a lack of community care service evaluation system and a lack of measurement of the service quality. This paper used literature review, indicator construction as the main methodologies to research tree aspects: the definition of community care service for elderly; preliminary construct the frame of community care service system for elderly; develop an evaluation system of community care services for elderly.

articleTitle: The hybrid recommendation model of commodity based on parallel computing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Instead of hybrid recommendation, recommendation system research mainly focused on improving the traditional algorithm. So, this paper proposes the hybrid recommendation model of commodity based on parallel computing. This model improves the results of the recommendation through combining various ways that have existed in the main e-commerce websites. In this model, there is one big problem that the amount of calculation is beyond the scope of our ability. Parallel computing can effectively solve this problem. The result shows that this model can provide users with accurate and effective recommendation.

articleTitle: Simulation research of Beijing urban distribution based on the coordinated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the development of Integration of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region, some function of capital will gradually move out. This stratagem how to influence the transportation, environment and logistics industry of Beijing will a current topic in the future. This paper established an Anylogic simulation model to simulate different logistics center will lead to what kind of result. We investigated 11 logistic center, which produce four demand distribution (business circle distribution, hospital distribution, uniform distribution and delivery distribution). Then we analyze the simulation result in the two aspects, namely distribution node and distribution lines. Finally, this paper mainly use Excel software to display directly the different logistics center produce different influence. Besides, this paper provides some advice for designing distribution planning and has profound influence on realize the integration.

articleTitle: Study on the recycling cooperation in reverse logistics participating in multi-client to multi-agent under multi-stage
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With the apposed system of Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), manufacturers can adopt the third-party recycling mode instead of its extended responsibility. Based on the recycling cooperation structure model of M nodes with multi-client to multi-agent, using game theory analyze the partnership among the different benefit bodies of the recycling structure deeply. And then have a conclusion that the number of the participating company of any node has dual effects. One effect is with the increasing the number of the participating company of any node, the recycling quantity and the entrusted price will increasing, this will be conducive to environmental protection. And the other is with the increasing the number of the participating company of any node, it will lead to decrease the recycling benefit not only to the whole structure, but also to every node, even to every company participating in any node.

articleTitle: The reasearch of the confidential self-inspection automation for the military units
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: At present, the situation about keeping secret in military fields is still very serious. In order to strengthen the security work of national defense industry, the CPC Central Committee has carried out the national weaponry secret qualification of production unit of scientific research examine authentication. The work can be compared as a total war that all the military units are all full mobilization, and concentrate to fight. A complete security management system in military research unit has been a certain degree of popularity, while the unit self-inspection system for confidential qualification system established does not exist. In allusion to the phenomena, this paper brings forward an automatic scoring system for the military units based on the high consequence department.

articleTitle: Study on quantity flexibility supply chain contract based on system dynamics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Supply chain contract is becoming an academic and business circles' hot topic. This paper built a two-echelon supply chain structure model with the quantity flexibility supply contract, and then simulated this model. The research indicated that the complex relation among factors of quantity flexibility supply contract could be better revealed with the use of system dynamics methodology. Finally, under the conditions in this paper, an optimal set of parameters that can coordinate the supply chain would be given to the retailer.

articleTitle: Can delivery speed affect sale in ecommerce: Evidence from household appliance
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: China's ecommerce merchants now face fierce competition in fast delivery that brings difficulty in balancing the cost and customer satisfaction. This study aims to investigate Chinese consumers' cognition on delivery speed when shopping online. We tested the interaction between delivery speed and other variations by setting laboratory experiment. It is found that the delivery speed is not the most important factor affecting the purchasing intention for China's online consumers. They are not sensitive to the difference between 1-day delivery and 7-days delivery. Although consumers' preference is not always the same when facing different products, even the product in the same category, they consider after-sale policy and even some petty benefits more attractive. The results suggest that China's ecommerce merchants avoid direct competition in fast delivery by differentiating other services attributes.

articleTitle: EVA model in enterprise valuation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: EVA, as a performance assessment or evaluation in the enterprise (or departments), is more and more widely used. Right now, EVA is gradually being applied to the field of business valuation. However, the existing EVA evaluation model is obviously insufficient, especially not accurately reflects the impact of the profit and loss forecast for each year of the enterprise value of existence. In this paper, the EVA evaluation model is modified to overcome the defects of the model. After introducing each main parameter in the modified EVA model, differences between EVA evaluation model and net profit evaluation model after modification is presented. Then the condition of use of modified EVA evaluation model applications is revealed.

articleTitle: Seasonal product pricing under RFID application environment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Seasonal products such as apparel or electronic products have the characteristics of short lifecycle. The uncertain demand in their short lifecycle makes the challenge on seasonal products supply chain management. The value of seasonal products which decreases quickly has affected on the pricing of the product. RFID platform could trace the product value along the supply chain and support a proper pricing for the seasonal product, which is very important for seasonal supply chain management. In this paper, based on updated product value information from RFID platform the pricing model for seasonal product supply chain is studied. And, the simulation shows the effectiveness of model.

articleTitle: Research on project financing modes of BOT and PPP based on case studies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The scale and quantity of the domestic engineering construction increase continuously with the developing and good operation of the state economy. At the same time, the degree and scope of financing have constantly deepened. The executive meetings of the State Council in 2014 indicated that innovation mechanism of investment and financing should be promoted and PPP financing mode deserved to be widely replicated and expanded. PPP mode is confronting more opportunity of development in the construction industry. However, it is very easy to confuse PPP with BOT mode in the actual operating process. The paper will analysis the fact in respect of financing for the Laibin B project approved by the State Government implemented in China and Beijing Metro line 4 built in PPP mode. A comparison will be made separately between the two modes of financing for the concession projects and concluded the inter-relation and differences between the two modes by case studies.

articleTitle: Research on the energy efficiency and coordinating relations of the transportation in guangdong province
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: From the perspectives of energy consumption efficiency and coordination, we discuss the relationships among the Guangdong transportation energy consumption, turnover, and the added value. Based on the calculations of the energy consumption efficiency transportation turnover and the added value, the results show that, the Guangdong transportation energy consumption efficiency is below the national average, and the transportation energy consumption is below the average of the entire province national economy industry. Using the coupling model to analysis the coordination of Guangdong transportation energy consumption, turnover, and the added value, the results show that, the most corresponding yearly data are disharmonious. Accordingly, optimizing transport structure, implementing traffic science and technology innovation, and improving the transportation organization management are recommended to improve the efficiency of transportation energy consumption, which enable the coordinated development of the transport energy consumption and turnover, as well as the coordinated development of transport energy consumption and added value.

articleTitle: Logistics cloud service context description
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: For the matching relation between the logistics cloud service and logistics task in cloud logistics systems, the description method of logistics cloud service based on context was proposed. Firstly, build the concept model of logistics cloud service, then designed cloud logistics domain context ontology and analyzed the description of logistics cloud service by introducing the definition of context, finally, a case was used to verify the effectiveness and practical of the reasoning method.

articleTitle: Optimal inventory policy for perishable products without replenishment
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Many products are perishable, and can be replenished in short term, for example, the vegetables. Therefore, it is important for wholesalers of such products to make right inventory decisions so that they can stock an appropriate amount of products and dynamically sell them at the right time with right quantity. In this paper, we try to address the optimal purchase and inventory control problem for a perishable product without replenishment based on the market condition and the perishable nature of product. Specifically, a two-period model is studied, and the optimal purchase policy and optimal inventory allocation policy are derived.

articleTitle: Traffic mode share analysis under competition of CRH sleeper and aviation in Beijing-guangzhou transportation corridor
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this article, a model is constructed based on MNL model (namely Multinomial Logit model) to study on the passenger flow sharing rate between Beijing-Guangzhou CRH (namely China Railway High-speed) sleeper train (referred to as “the train” hereinafter) and aviation. With orthogonal SP (namely Stated Preference) data and NLOGIT software, parameters of this model are calibrated. Aggregate analysis on passenger flow share ratio, elastic analysis and simulation under a specific situation are conducted as well. Then the varying situation of share ratio of the train can be made clear under specific conditions. According to the simulation results, the selection rate of the train lacks elastic to the price and traveling time. Increasing ticket price can make up for passenger loss, and improving comfort level of the train can as well. The aim of this paper is to provide a scientific basis for the sharing rate algorithm of transportation modes, and provide ideas for the realization of dynamic fare according to the scene simulation.

articleTitle: A hierarchical wind driven optimization method for solving the bi-level programming problem
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: A hierarchical wind driven optimization (WDO) method is proposed to solve the bi-level programming problem. Firstly, the WDO method is used to optimize the lower level programming problem after the upper level variables are initialized, and the positions and velocities of air parcels in the lower level are updated. Then the solutions of the upper level are optimized by the WDO method with the constrained conditions. Finally, the solutions with the minimum sum of sequences of the two-level results are selected as the final solution from the solution set. The experimental results of the proposed algorithm show the effectiveness of the proposed hierarchical wind driven optimization for solving the bi-level programming problems.

articleTitle: The research on the status-quo of local life service
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of E-commerce has produced a tremendous effect on people's life and traditional industries. “Internet Plus” proposed by the premier on the two sessions (NPC & CPPCC) has boosted the accelerated integration of traditional industries and the internet. Local life service is closely related to people's lives which also continue to be combined with the Internet Life service area which most closely with people also continue to be combined with the internet. Local life service booming.

articleTitle: A hybrid algorithm for the Truck-and-Trailer Routing Problem with time windows
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The Truck-and-Trailer Routing Problem (TTRP) is a variant of the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP). The TTRP extends the basic VRP to take a real-life application into account. This study considers TTRP with time window constraints, and establishes a mathematical model. In addition, a two-stage hybrid algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. In the first stage, the rule of Nearest Neighborhood is applied to produce the initial feasible solutions; and in the second stage, the solutions are carried into the route improvement by the tabu search algorithm. Compared with the results obtained by Lingo, the hybrid algorithm can obtain good quality solutions with less time cost for most cases. Moreover, this research establishes a test bank of 18 TTRPTW questions, and composes the program by the C language to carry out the test on personal PC. The test results show the solution produced by the algorithm can reduce the total cost effectively.

articleTitle: Dual-channel ordering strategy of new energy vehicles
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Promotion of new energy vehicles (NEVs) is an important strategy to cope with the energy challenges and environmental pollution. In this paper, we propose a dual-channel supply chain model to study the optimal strategy in promotion of new energy vehicles with consideration of subsidies. We present the properties of the models and analyze the influence of the proportion of sales orders, government subsidies, and wholesale prices. We find that government subsidies affect the optimal ordering decision in different dual-channel strategies.

articleTitle: Study on the agricultural product distribution route under agricultural super docking mode
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper analyzes several circulation models of the agricultural super docking, and points out some produce distribution problems under these models. The conception of loss function is introduced to establish the mathematical model, which is based on the produce delivery. The GA (Genetic Algorithm) is also used to figure out the optimal path.

articleTitle: Government subsidies for straw recycling
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The present stage of China is in the process from traditional agriculture to modern agriculture, thus calls for the efficient use of resources including using economical resources intensively and promoting energy conservation of agriculture actively. Straw as a versatile renewable biological resources can be processed into organic fertilizer, fodder, building materials, gas and so on. However, farmers in the various rural areas generally burn straw in the actual use, not only a waste of resources, but also a cause of the worsening haze. Researching the basis of government financial subsidies for straw recycling and formulating the rational financial subsidies, can mobilize farmers' enthusiasm for recycling straw, improve the efficiency of straw recycling effectively, and realize economy of recycling agriculture ultimately.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation of technology innovation based on improved matter-element model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Technology innovation is an important driven force for the economic development, the risk of which deserves attentions, and to evaluate risk accurately and effectively can be helpful to improve the success rate of technology innovation. As the risk of technology innovation is of strong uncertainty and fuzziness, the existing risk evaluation methods have certain limitations, while matter-element model can support these characteristics of problems. In this paper we improve the matter-element model, to construct indicator system of technology innovation risk, and determine the weight of indicators through a minimum deviation method integrating AHP weight and entropy weight, to evaluate the risk of technology innovation. Finally the calculation procedure and effectiveness of our method is illustrated via a case study.

articleTitle: Allocating profits among collaborative carriers in less-than-truckload industry
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Though there are many less-than-truckload (LTL) companies, the LTL industry is still in a decentralized structure and the market is dispersive. Under the influence of economic recession and regional restriction in self-development, LTL companies urgently form a collaborative logistics network that is based on each's existed facilities and networks to make up their own deficiencies, share resources, reduce costs, enlarge market share and improve service quality. Profit allocation is a key issue to ensure the stability of collaboration. This paper researches on the profit allocation problem between two collaborative LTL companies. Different from other methods to calculate participants' weights, we propose a new one that considers both “profit per cost” and “profit per price” before and after collaboration. According to cooperative game theory's principles, the paper testifies the effectiveness of this method and then applies it to some instances. The paper provides reference for profit allocation among collaborative companies.

articleTitle: The model for the online shopping supply chain and its optimization based on online to offline
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: With regard to the network optimization problem of online supply chain based on online to offline, the super network theory is used to construct the model of the supply chain. Then the independent optimization is modeled based on the single supply chain member, and the integrated optimization is modeled based on all the supply chain members according to the optimization theory of the variational inequality. Further more, the two models are compared by simulation application. Finally, the paper concludes the supply chain can gain more economic benefit and bring win-win effect to all its members if they invest on the online to offline operation on the condition that all its members' profit is maximized.

articleTitle: Study on evolutionary game of enterprise-oriented university-industry cooperation knowledge flow
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Enterprise-oriented university-industry cooperation is a major mode of Industry university cooperation, rapid development in recent years. But compared with western developed countries, there are still significant gaps. So the theory of enterprise-oriented university-industry cooperation research needs to be strengthened. This article will treat cooperation as process of knowledge flow, relying on a large number of outstanding cases, using evolutionary game theory, from the aspect of relationship mode selection, giving stable equilibrium of knowledge flow between groups. Analyze stable equilibrium points about in different conditions which strategy set will be adopted.

articleTitle: Order promising model with random demand and supply
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies the order promising problems that frequently arise in EMS-OEM scenario with multiple demand classes. Demands and replenishment of inventory in different periods are assumed to be random variables and independent of one another. An order promising system is designed to maximize the expected net profit over the planning horizon by determining the fraction of the demand that is likely to be fulfilled from the inventory and the delivery date. The expected future replenishments are included to deal with incoming orders and order acceptance and delivery dates are determined as appropriate. Finally, computational experiments are used to illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed approaches, and evaluate the applicability of the proposed models.

articleTitle: Research on the application of data mining technology in user management of P2P network financial platform
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Recently, a large number of P2P network financial platforms emerged, market competition is fierce. With the size of platforms and the number of customers increasing, how to effectively manage the users on the platforms has become an urgent problem to be solved for network financial platforms. Also, effective user management will be the key to keeping the competitive advantage. For network financial platforms, compared to borrowers, lenders play a more important role. The activity and loyalty of the lenders can be said to be the basis for healthy operation of the platform. Therefore, the use of data mining technology has a great significance for effectively managing the lenders. This paper selects a representative P2P network financial platform as the research object, using the data mining tool-WEKA and the K-means clustering algorithm, achieves the effective classification of the lenders on the platform based on the establishment of corresponding mathematical model, and provides some appropriate suggestions and strategies for effectively managing the lenders on the P2P network financial platforms.

articleTitle: Analysis of the competition between CRH sleeper and aviation in Beijing-guangzhou corridor based on SP survey
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper analyzed the influences which ticket price, travel time and comfort degree have on traffic mode choice in Beijing-Guangzhou transportation corridor under various trip purposes. A SP-RP survey was applied and the price elasticity of demand and cross price elasticity were calculated respectively. By doing statistical analysis, we found that the ticket price has obvious influence on traffic mode choice under the trip purposes of tourism, migrant and school. Business trip has the highest demand for travel time. Comfort degree is a particular important factor in aviation when it comes to tourism. Elastic analysis results show that CRH sleeper has higher price elasticity of demand than aviation, which indicates that the price of CRH sleeper has more influence on traffic demand than that of aviation's. The result of cross price elasticity calculation shows that the competitiveness of CRH sleeper is declining with the increase of CRH sleeper ticket price. This research could provide evidence for dynamic pricing of CRH sleeper in competitive environment.

articleTitle: A research on logistics model of electric energy metering device considering its continuous detection process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we study a practical problem on logistics management of the electric energy metering device (EEMD) in State Grid Corporation of China. We establish an integer programming model to make the optimization decisions for the setting of initial inventories of EEMD (which need to be detected) and detected electric energy metering device (D-EEMD, which need to be distributed) in every single period based on a continuous detection process. Considering the time window of delivery and storage, and the capacity of vehicle which can be dispatched, we optimize the inventory cost and vehicle dispatching cost with the detecting line operating continuously. Finally, we provide a solution of the practical problem and obtain some managerial insights by a numerical analysis using Matlab. We believe that our findings will bring forward some useful suggestions to logistics managers in power and grid industry.

articleTitle: Post evaluation of success degree of a library overhaul and energy-saving renovation project
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, success degree fuzzy comprehensive evaluation(FCE) method is adopted for the post evaluation of success degree based on a library overhaul and energy-saving renovation project, evaluation results are acquired, detailed analysis are carried out, suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: The application of data mining in the analysis of high underpricing rate of IPO
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In order to explain the reason of the high underpricing rate of IPO and to judge whether there exists IPO underpricing, combined with China's specific policy system, this paper classified the IPO first-day underpricing or discount and constructed a classifier by using the decision tree modeling under the multiple influence factors. The numbers listed in this article refer to the data of initial public offerings from September 2006 to December 2014 with a sample. On the basis of the conclusion, this paper suggested to strengthen investors reasoningly investing.

articleTitle: The optimal quilibrium of the capital constrained green supply chain under bank credit
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: This paper studies the equilibrium of a capital constrained green supply chain which is made of a manufacturer and a retailer under bank credit, a multiplicative demand function is established, and the effect of quantity and product green degree are introduced into the newsboy model, then the retailer's optimal order quantity and the manufacturer's optimal degree of green goods are obtained, and compare the equilibrium solution sunder centralized and decentralized decision-making, finally with revenue sharing contract and buyback contract the green supply chain achieved coordination.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of the supervision system on entry special articles
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Special articles refer to microorganisms, human tissues, biological products, blood and blood products in need of special management in entry administration. Such articles are related to national biological safety and people's life safety, and have always been the key regulatory objects in entry and exit inspection and quarantine. How to improve the efficiency of the inspection and quarantine supervision system has become the common aspiration of governments, enterprises, research institutes and other social sectors while ensuring the regulatory safety. On the basis of the original inspection and quarantine supervision system for special articles, this paper further improved the supervision and management process and established a more rigorous whole-process supervision system for special articles to better serve the social and economic development and scientific and technological progress while supervising the safety of special articles.

articleTitle: Analysis on business defect management driving and enabling factors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Analyze business defect management driving and enabling factors from the organizational level, the team level and the individual level. Regression analysis model verified driving and enabling factors at different levels. Driving factors on the organizational level include the support of senior managers, incentive and control mechanism, subjective norm and perceived behavior. Driving factors on the team level include team creativity, team supervision, team work, team self reflection and team learning capability. Driving factors on the individual level include employee self-efficacy, proactive behavior, employee creativity, organizational climate and organizational psychological ownership. Enabling factors include trust, communication, coordination and organization culture.

articleTitle: Coordination of online dual-channel supply chain under differentiated products
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The conflict of dual channel has become more and more competitive. In order to alleviate the conflict, the paper studies that the manufacturer not only sells the products through the traditional online retail channel but also the online direct channel. This paper analyzes the product pricing, service level and the profit of the whole supply chain under centralized decision-making, and the product pricing, service level and the maximum profit of the manufacturer and the online retailer under decentralized decision-making. The results show that double marginalization effect exists in the online dual-channel. It concludes the condition of the supply chain coordination through revenue sharing contract model. Finally, it verifies that the revenue sharing contract is effective through the example analysis. The research can enrich the theoretical knowledge of online dual channel.

articleTitle: The game of excess profits of logistics alliance distribution based on fair seats
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: The distribution of profits is a very important problem in logistics alliance and a fair plan for distribution plays a significant role in keeping logistics alliance stable and strong. According to the rate of the contribution which the allied member made in profits, the problem about unfair distribution among the allied members can be solved combined with distribution for fair seats. Distributing step by step can ensure each part of profits fair distribution by dividing profits into units. This model is feasible, which proved by the analysis in the example.

articleTitle: Key factors influencing adoption of the new energy vehicles in China
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: New energy vehicles have become an important part of the national strategy to increase energy efficiency, decrease vehicle pollutant emissions, and upgrade the automotive industry. However, the adoption of new energy vehicles faces various challenges. In this paper, we identify the special inhibitors that find in China in addition to the commonly shared influencing factors found worldwide. We show that the influencing factors are interrelated. Our work help policy makers and NEV market players to better identify the inhibitors and to work out corresponding strategies.

articleTitle: Letv's acquisition of flowers film and Letv new media: A case study based on event and accounting method
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Video website is one of the fast growing Internet industry in recent years. Although the network video industry maintains a steady market expansion, long-term loss issues of the major online video sites remain unresolved. In order to achieve economies of scale and relieve stress, merger and acquisition (M&A) events between the video sites occur frequently. Can video sites get rid of loss-making dilemma through the merger integration has been a hot topic in academia. Taking Letv's acquisition of Flowers Film and Letv New Media as an example, this paper applied event and accounting study method to research the effects of the M&A event on Letv's performance from the short-term and long-term perspectives. And this paper explored the implications of M&A events for the future development of the network video industry. The results showed that, in the short term, the acquisition can create positive value for the stock holders. And in the medium to long term, the acquisition will enable Letv keep growing. In the new media age, “content is king”. Creating the “platform & content & terminal & application” of the industrial ecological chain will be more beneficial to the future development of China's online video industry.

articleTitle: Modelling of intelligent publishing cloud platform based on internet +
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Influenced by the digital publishing and other emerging publishing, the traditional publishing industry is facing severe challenges. We think that the Big Data, cloud computing, mobile Internet, great collaboration and other advanced management concepts and technology can help the traditional publishing industry break the current impasse. Based on the collaboration theory, by using the mobile Internet technology, service-oriented cloud computing architecture, and combined with Big Data analysis techniques, this paper builds an intelligent, efficient, and secure intelligent publishing cloud platform. The platform has the characteristics of O2O operation mode, intelligent publishing, social marketing and so on, which aims to achieve the integration of publishing resources, improve the response speed of publishing services and user experience, and thus enhance the service capabilities and professional level of the entire publishing industry.

articleTitle: Research on the logistics efficiency by and simulation of tianjin port
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze logistic input-output efficiency of Tianjin port in past five years based on DEA. The results show that the logistic input-output of Tianjin port was non DEA efficiency, and scale reward increased. Then we conduct simulation using witness in three situations, linked respectively to adding the number of quay cranes, scaling up the berthing capacity and increasing the number of locks. The illustrative example indicates the number of quay cranes and locks are bottlenecks of development of Tianjin port. But the berth does not play a major role when the proportion of quay cranes and locks is 5:1, the efficiency of Tianjin port logistics will achieve the optimal.

articleTitle: Influencing factors of highly send and transfer stocks: Evidence from Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Dividends distribution of Chinese listed companies is different from other countries, where exits a particular phenomenon called highly send and transfer stocks especially in growth enterprise (hereinafter referred to with GEM). This paper empirically investigates the influencing factors of highly send and transfer stocks, and tests hypothesizes of highly send and transfer stocks. Different from current literature, this paper is the first to overall investigate the influencing factors of highly send and transfer stocks, and test different hypothesizes of highly send and transfer stocks to study motivation of Chinese particular economic environment. New findings of this paper are as follows. First, there are five main influencing factors of highly send and transfer stocks: stock price; capital sharer, earnings per share, growth of net profit, and market book ratio. Second, earnings accumulation is fundamental condition of highly send and transfer stocks. Third, five hypothesizes which are “optimal price hypothesis”, “price illusion hypothesis”, “capital expansion hypothesis”, “dividend cater hypothesis” and “signaling hypothesis” of motivation of highly send and transfer stocks are all applicable in Chinese market. These findings have implications for investors to recognize the nature of the dividend policy of Chinese listed companies, and obtain excess returns from highly send and transfer stocks. And for regulators guide the behavior of investors and improve the efficiency of stock market trading.

articleTitle: Research on the problem of warehouse supervisors' arrangement of medicine logistics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In the activities of the medicine logistics, statistics of in-&-out-of-storage management of drug has always been the emphasis and difficulty in management. The WMS system can play a key role, but for some pharmaceutical factories which are not willing to cooperate with the system, extra supervisors are necessary to deal with this problem. By considering with the adjustment of quantity and level of supervisors, this article finds a way to make the quantity of the inventory and outbound as accurate as possible, and provides certain scientific basis on developing more scientific and reasonable warehouse personnel arrangement.

articleTitle: The marketing strategy research on the O2O model online order meals system in college students group
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Online ordering meals is in recent years with the development of network technology, a new form of dining. Although the online ordering system has entered people's lives, but are not mature enough, still has great room for development. Therefore study how to marketing online ordering system is a very necessary research. In this article, from the marketing to analysis the online order meals system to find the appeared problems in the rapid development, and then give some more feasible marketing strategy.

articleTitle: Joint decision on promotion and inventory control for similar item under capacity constraints
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: B2C e-commerce enterprises offer many the different kinds but the same variety items are often susceptible to periods of inventory mismatches where best-selling items may face shortages while poor-selling items have excess inventories. Because of capacity constraints, it is a problem that how to sell those poor-selling items quickly and purchase more best-selling items for maximize revenue. In the literature review, many different algorithms for a product's promotion and order have been proposed. However, there are relatively few studies on how to deal with different items can improve inventory. In this paper, one of joint decision on promotion and inventory control model are investigated about best-selling items and poor-selling items. We discussed the optimal combination strategy of promote and order about the similar item under the capacity constraints. Finally, we will compare the profit of promotion and original profit. The results show that the reasonable promotion and ordering combination can increase returns of B2C e-commerce enterprises.

articleTitle: The study on executives' competing for corporate control in China's private listed companies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Along with the development of split-share reform and capital market, the trend of equity decentralization in listed companies is becoming more and more obvious. Professional managers' betrayal of large shareholders frequently occurs, which leads to the competing for corporate control between executives and shareholders. This paper studies on the corporate control from the perspective of competing for corporate control between executives and shareholders. We analyze the executives' means of competing and try to find out how executives possess more corporate control by competing for board seats, uniting inside directors and transactional institutional investors.

articleTitle: Supply chain performance under consignment contract with time-and-price sensitive demands
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, we construct the decentralized and centralized decision-making models of supply chain under consignment contract based on uncertain response time and time-price sensitive demands in a two-stage supply chain system. And we solve the models to find the optimal solutions. At the same time, the effectiveness of each decision-making mode on supply chain profits is discussed by comparing the supply chain total profits. The results of research show that for a two-stage supply chain under consignment contract, the supply chain total profits in centralized-making decision mode is always higher than that in decentralized case. In addition, when the supplier's average response time is shorter, and the sensitivity of customer demand to supply chain response time and product price is lower, the implementation of centralized decision-making mode is more favorable.

articleTitle: Research of the influence of logistics service negative comments on online sales
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In this paper, by researching logistics service negative comments about innovative products and functional products, such as the length quantity and content of the comment, we study on the correlation between online sales and logistics service. We make a survey on the negative comments about logistics data based in Taobao from Jun to Oct in 2015. Then through the correlation analysis, we draw a conclusion that as for functional products, most factors about logistics service have greater influence on online sales than that for innovative products, except for delivery efficiency.

articleTitle: Profiles of dual commitment to the company and union: Relations to turnover intentions and organizational citizenship behavior
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: In commitment research it is getting more and more attention to identify homogeneous subgroups with varying configurations of commitment foci and mindsets. The union and the company are two dominant forces in labor relations. We identified profiles of commitment to them in a sample of 1395 employees of Chinese non-state-owned enterprises. Using latent profile analyses, we distinguished six distinct profiles, full commitment, EB-dominant, AC/NC-dominant, moderate commitment, CC-dominant, and uncommitted. Turnover intentions and two dimensions of organizational citizenship behavior varied across six distinct profile groups. Implications of result are discussed.

articleTitle: Science & technology industry cluster's collaborative innovation risks identification — Based on sustainable innovation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Logistics, Informatics and Service Sciences (LISS)
abstract: Science and technology industry clusters in the process of collaborative innovation put up many characteristics, such as network coordination, benefit-sharing, risk-sharing and other special dynamic complexity. By studying the features above, to establish a model that is based on innovation chain of science and technology industry cluster's sustainable collaborative innovation. Taking flow chart analysis into consideration, ensure the innovation chain's body and in accordance with the system operation to identify the risks on the system level and the innovation process risks that may occur during the process to discuss the reasons for diversification of risks arising. In order to be able to effectively control the risk, we need to recognize this dynamic innovative risk analysis, by combining the process analysis and development of science and technology industry cluster system based on sustainable collaborative innovation to find the source of risks.
